<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2) below, the following provisions of the 1995 Act shall (insofar as not already in force) come into force on 14th July 2000:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/180/article/2/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/180/article/2/1/a" id="article-2-1-a">

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/180/article/2/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/180/article/2/1/b" id="article-2-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/180/article/2/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/180/article/2/1/c" id="article-2-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/180/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/180/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/180/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/180/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where, before 14th July 2000:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/180/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/180/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an abatement notice has been served under section 80(1) of the 1990 Act; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2000/180/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2000/180/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>such notice, complaint or order, and any proceedings consequent thereon shall continue to have effect notwithstanding the amendments made to section 79 of the 1990 Act by paragraph 89 of Schedule 22 to the 1995 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006 (Commencement No. 1, Savings and Transitional Provisions) Order 2006</dc:title><Made Date="2006-09-28"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 1, Savings and Transitional Provisions) Order 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006 asp 11">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Animal Health and Welfare (Scotland) Act 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to the particular purpose specified in article 3, and to the savings and transitional provisions contained in article 4, the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act (except sections 53 to 55) is 6th October 2006 except for the following provisions–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 20(1) to (3); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 52 insofar as introducing paragraphs 6, 9(b), (h) to (l), (n) and (p) of schedule 2 to the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 52 insofar as introducing paragraph 9(d) of schedule 2 to the Act shall come into force on 6th October 2006 only for the purpose of the repeal of section 3 (pets not to be sold to children under twelve years of age) of the Pet Animals Act 1951<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a court has imposed, by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, a disqualification on a person from having custody of any animal or any specified kind of animal, section 40(11) of the Act shall apply to a person who breaches such an order as it applies to a person who breaches a disqualification order imposed under section 40(1) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person has been convicted of an offence under section 40(11) of the Act, by virtue of breaching a disqualification imposed by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 39 of the Act shall have effect with the substitution for the words “owning or keeping an animal” in subsection (10)(d) of “having custody of an animal in breach of disqualification under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1954/40" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1954" Number="0040">1954 (c. 40)</Citation>”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person has custody of an animal in breach of a disqualification imposed by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 41 of the Act shall apply to such a breach as it does to a breach of a disqualification order imposed under section 40(1) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/d" id="article-4-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person is disqualified, by virtue of an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 42 of the Act shall apply as it does in relation to a person who is disqualified by virtue of an order under section 40(1) of the Act with the exception of section 42(2)(c)(i) which shall be omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any Code of Recommendations issued under section 3 of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> shall be treated as an animal welfare code of practice made by the Scottish Ministers under section 37 of the Act and approved by resolution of the Scottish Parliament.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sections 2, 6, 7 and 8<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968 shall continue to apply for the purposes of the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Scotland) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> and the Welfare of Livestock (Prohibited Operations) Regulations 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a court has imposed, by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, a disqualification on a person from having custody of any animal or any specified kind of animal, section 40(11) of the Act shall apply to a person who breaches such an order as it applies to a person who breaches a disqualification order imposed under section 40(1) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person has been convicted of an offence under section 40(11) of the Act, by virtue of breaching a disqualification imposed by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 39 of the Act shall have effect with the substitution for the words “owning or keeping an animal” in subsection (10)(d) of “having custody of an animal in breach of disqualification under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1954/40" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomPublicGeneralAct" Year="1954" Number="0040">1954 (c. 40)</Citation>”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person has custody of an animal in breach of a disqualification imposed by an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 41 of the Act shall apply to such a breach as it does to a breach of a disqualification order imposed under section 40(1) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/1/d" id="article-4-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Where a person is disqualified, by virtue of an order under section 1 of the Protection of Animals (Amendment) Act 1954, section 42 of the Act shall apply as it does in relation to a person who is disqualified by virtue of an order under section 40(1) of the Act with the exception of section 42(2)(c)(i) which shall be omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any Code of Recommendations issued under section 3 of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> shall be treated as an animal welfare code of practice made by the Scottish Ministers under section 37 of the Act and approved by resolution of the Scottish Parliament.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2006/482/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2006/482/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sections 2, 6, 7 and 8<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> of the Agriculture (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1968 shall continue to apply for the purposes of the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Scotland) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> and the Welfare of Livestock (Prohibited Operations) Regulations 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement No. 1, Transitional, Transitory and Saving Provisions) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-09-13"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation><Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1, Transitional, Transitory and Saving Provisions) Order 2012 and comes into force on 1st October 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 asp 5">2005 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 asp 8">2012 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>1st October 2012 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the 2012 Act specified in column 1 of the Schedule to this Order (the subject-matter of which is described in column 2 of the Schedule).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a purpose is specified in column 3 of the Schedule in relation to any provision, that provision comes into force on 1st October 2012 for that purpose only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 35(1) of the 2012 Act (annual police plans) does not apply in respect of any yearly period which begins before 1st April 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which section 71 of the 2012 Act (Her Majesty’s inspectors of constabulary in Scotland) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The reference in section 34(5)(a)(ii) of the 2012 Act (strategic police plan) to the inspectors of constabulary is construed as if it were a reference to the inspectors of constabulary appointed under section 33(1) of the Police (Scotland) Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which section 6 of the 2012 Act (the Police Service of Scotland) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 42(4) of the 2012 Act (examination of Police Service by Auditor General) is modified as follows—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/a" id="article-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (a), omit “or the Police Service”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/b" id="article-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (b), after “resources” insert “the chief constable considers will be”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which paragraph 33(11) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (interpretation) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of section 66 of the 2012 Act (investigations: procedure), the following terms in the section inserted by that section have the following meanings—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“chief constable” means the chief constable appointed under section 7 of the 2012 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“senior officers” means chief constables, deputy chief constables and assistant chief constables of police forces established under the Police (Scotland) Act 1967;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“superintendents” and “chief superintendents” mean superintendents and chief superintendents of police forces established under the Police (Scotland) Act 1967; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the Authority” means the Scottish Police Authority.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which the repeal of section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>42 of the 2005 Act (reporting) by schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>8 to the 2012 Act comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Despite the amendments made by paragraph<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>68(15) and (16) of schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>7 to the 2012 Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/a" id="article-7-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>40(1), (3) and (6) of the 2005 Act (framework document) continue to have effect on and after 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012 as they had effect before that date, but only in relation to the framework document given effect by the Fire and Rescue Services (Framework) (Scotland) Order 2012<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b" id="article-7-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>41(1), (2), (4), (5) and (6) of the 2005 Act (adherence) continue to have effect on and after 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012 as they had effect before that date, but only in relation to—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/i" id="article-7-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the framework document mentioned in paragraph<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>(a); and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/ii" id="article-7-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>any order made under section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>41(4) of the 2005 Act before 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/1" id="article-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraphs (2) and (3) have effect until the day on which the amendments made by paragraph 68(20) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act come into force (interpretation).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/2" id="article-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of section 114 of the 2012 Act (strategic plan), in relation to the insertion of section 41A into the 2005 Act (SFRS’s first strategic plan), the reference in section 41A(4)(a) to the framework document is construed as a reference to the document prepared under, and having effect by virtue of, section 40 of the 2005 Act as amended by paragraph 68(15) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (SFRS framework document).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/3" id="article-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph 68(16) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (adherence to framework document), in relation to the amendments made to section 41 of the 2005 Act, the references in those amendments to the framework document are construed as references to the document prepared under, and having effect by virtue of, section 40 of the 2005 Act as amended by paragraph 68(15) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (SFRS framework document).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement No. 1, Transitional, Transitory and Saving Provisions) Order 2012</dc:title><Made Date="2012-09-13"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation><Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1, Transitional, Transitory and Saving Provisions) Order 2012 and comes into force on 1st October 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 asp 5">2005 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 asp 8">2012 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>1st October 2012 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the 2012 Act specified in column 1 of the Schedule to this Order (the subject-matter of which is described in column 2 of the Schedule).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a purpose is specified in column 3 of the Schedule in relation to any provision, that provision comes into force on 1st October 2012 for that purpose only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 35(1) of the 2012 Act (annual police plans) does not apply in respect of any yearly period which begins before 1st April 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which section 71 of the 2012 Act (Her Majesty’s inspectors of constabulary in Scotland) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The reference in section 34(5)(a)(ii) of the 2012 Act (strategic police plan) to the inspectors of constabulary is construed as if it were a reference to the inspectors of constabulary appointed under section 33(1) of the Police (Scotland) Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which section 6 of the 2012 Act (the Police Service of Scotland) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 42(4) of the 2012 Act (examination of Police Service by Auditor General) is modified as follows—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/a" id="article-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (a), omit “or the Police Service”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/5/2/b" id="article-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (b), after “resources” insert “the chief constable considers will be”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which paragraph 33(11) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (interpretation) comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of section 66 of the 2012 Act (investigations: procedure), the following terms in the section inserted by that section have the following meanings—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“chief constable” means the chief constable appointed under section 7 of the 2012 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“senior officers” means chief constables, deputy chief constables and assistant chief constables of police forces established under the Police (Scotland) Act 1967;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“superintendents” and “chief superintendents” mean superintendents and chief superintendents of police forces established under the Police (Scotland) Act 1967; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the Authority” means the Scottish Police Authority.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article has effect until the day on which the repeal of section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>42 of the 2005 Act (reporting) by schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>8 to the 2012 Act comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Despite the amendments made by paragraph<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>68(15) and (16) of schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>7 to the 2012 Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/a" id="article-7-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>40(1), (3) and (6) of the 2005 Act (framework document) continue to have effect on and after 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012 as they had effect before that date, but only in relation to the framework document given effect by the Fire and Rescue Services (Framework) (Scotland) Order 2012<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b" id="article-7-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>41(1), (2), (4), (5) and (6) of the 2005 Act (adherence) continue to have effect on and after 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012 as they had effect before that date, but only in relation to—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/i" id="article-7-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the framework document mentioned in paragraph<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>(a); and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/7/2/b/ii" id="article-7-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>any order made under section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>41(4) of the 2005 Act before 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2012.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/1" id="article-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraphs (2) and (3) have effect until the day on which the amendments made by paragraph 68(20) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act come into force (interpretation).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/2" id="article-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of section 114 of the 2012 Act (strategic plan), in relation to the insertion of section 41A into the 2005 Act (SFRS’s first strategic plan), the reference in section 41A(4)(a) to the framework document is construed as a reference to the document prepared under, and having effect by virtue of, section 40 of the 2005 Act as amended by paragraph 68(15) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (SFRS framework document).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/253/article/8/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/253/article/8/3" id="article-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph 68(16) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (adherence to framework document), in relation to the amendments made to section 41 of the 2005 Act, the references in those amendments to the framework document are construed as references to the document prepared under, and having effect by virtue of, section 40 of the 2005 Act as amended by paragraph 68(15) of schedule 7 to the 2012 Act (SFRS framework document).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/333/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/333/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>1st January 2013 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the 2012 Act specified in column 1 of Schedule 1 (the subject-matter of which is described in column<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2 of that Schedule).</Text>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2012/333/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2012/333/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">

<Text>Where a purpose is specified in column 3 of Schedule 1 in relation to any provision, that provision comes into force on 1st January 2013 for that purpose only.</Text>

<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The “appointed day” for the purposes of schedule 6 to the 2012 Act (transfer of staff, property, <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>) is 1st April 2013.</Text>
</P1para>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement No. 4, Transitory and Transitional Provisions) Order 2013</dc:title><Made Date="2013-02-14"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2013/51/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2013/51/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2013/51/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2013/51/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 4, Transitory and Transitional Provisions) Order 2013 and comes into force on 1st April 2013.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2013/51/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2013/51/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “<Abbreviation Expansion="Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 asp 8">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2013/51/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2013/51/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>1st April 2013 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the Act, so far as not already in force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2013/51/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2013/51/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text><Character Name="EnSpace"/>Despite the coming into force of section 39 of the Act (the Scottish Police Authority’s annual report), the Authority is not required to produce an annual report for the reporting year ending on 31st March 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2013/51/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2013/51/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2013/51/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2013/51/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraph<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>(2) has effect until the date on which section 19 of the Road Safety Act 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> comes into force in relation to Scotland.</Text>

<P2para><Text>Until any regulations made under section 18 of the Regulatory Reform (Scotland) Act 2014<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> (regulations relating to protecting and improving the environment) are in force, the Act has effect subject to the following modifications.</Text>

<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in section 12(1) and (2), a landfill permit under regulations made under section 2 of the Pollution Prevention and Control Act 1999; and</Text></Para>

<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in sections 9, 10, 12(3) and (4) and 31—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">

<Para><Text>a waste management licence for the purpose of Part 2 of the Environmental Protection Act 1990; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a landfill permit under regulations made under section 2 of the Pollution Prevention and Control Act 1999,</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Offices, Shops and Railway Premises Act 1963 (Commencement No.1) Order 1964 1 Except in relation to the premises to which Article 2 of this Order applies, the provisions of the Offices, Shops and Railway Premises Act 1963 (hereafter in this Order referred to as “the Act”) specified in the first column of each of the Parts of Schedule 1 to this Order (which relate to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into operation on the day specified in the heading to the Part of that Schedule in which the provisions are specified. 2 In relation to premises which are in a covered market place, being a covered market place to which section 51 (power to adapt Act in relation to covered markets) of the Act relates, the provisions of the Act specified in Schedule 2 to this Order shall come into operation on 1st May 1964. 3 This Order may be cited as the Offices, Shops and Railway Premises Act 1963 (Commencement No.1) Order 1964. PART III PROVISIONS COMING INTO OPERATION ON 1ST AUGUST 1964
Provisions of the ActSubject matter of provisions
Sections 4 to 23General provisions relating to the health, safety and welfare of employees.
Section 27Penalization of dangerous acts and interference with equipment, &c.
Section 28Provision of means of escape in case of fire.
Section 29(1) and (3) to (11)Fire precautions: certification of certain premises by appropriate authority before persons are employed to work therein.
Section 30Maintenance of means of escape in case of fire, and inspection by appropriate authority.
Section 31Right of appeal against matters arising out of sections 29 and 30.
Section 32Power of magistrates' courts and sheriffs to make orders for putting down dangerous conditions in regard to means of escape in case of fire.
Section 33Safety provisions in case of fire.
Section 34Fire alarms.
Section 35Power of Minister of Labour to make regulations with respect to means of escape in case of fire.
Section 36Employees to be made familiar with means of escape in case of fire.
Section 37Fire prevention.
Section 38Provision of fire-fighting equipment.
Section 41Duty of fire authority to consult local building authority before requiring alterations.
Section 42(2) to (10) and (12) to (16)Special provisions with respect to buildings in single ownership of which a part consists of premises to which the Act applies.
Section 43(2) to (8), (9)(b) and (c) and (10) to (14)Special provisions with respect to buildings plurally owned of which a part consists of premises to which the Act applies.
Section 44Provisions with respect to contiguous fuel storage premises in single ownership.
Section 45Power of Minister of Labour to grant exemptions from certain requirements of the Act.
Section 47Prohibition of levying of charges on employees for things done in compliance with the Act.
Section 48Notification of accidents.
Section 50Information for employees.
Section 76(2) and (3)Amendment of Public Health Act 1936.
Section 77Exclusion of application of sections 128 and 129 of Public Health (London) Act 1936.
Section 83(1) (except in so far as it relates to section 24 of the Act), (3) (except as already in operation), (6) and (7)Application of the Act to the Crown.
Section 84Exclusion of application of the Act to visiting forces.
Section 91(4) and Schedule 2Repeal of enactments.

The Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 (Commencement No. 1) Order 1974 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 (Commencement No. 1) Order 1974. 2 The Interpretation Act 1889 shall apply to the interpretation of this Order as it applies to the interpretation of an Act of Parliament. 2 The provisions mentioned in the first column of each of the Schedules to this Order (which relate to the matters specified in the second column of each Schedule) shall come into operation— a in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 1, on 1st October 1974; b in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 2, on 1st January 1975; and c in the case of the provisions mentioned in Schedule 3, on 1st April 1975. SCHEDULE 1 PROVISIONS COMING INTO OPERATION ON 1ST OCTOBER 1974 Article 2(a)
ProvisionsSubject-matter of provisions
Section 1. General purposes of Part I of the Act.
Section 10(1) (so far as it relates to the Commission).Establishment of Commission.
Section 10(2) to (4) and section 10(6) and (7) (so far as aforesaid).Constitution and status of Commission.
Section 11(1) to (3) and section 11(6) (so far as aforesaid).General functions of Commission.
Section 12. Control of Commission by Secretary of State.
Section 13. Other powers of the Commission.
Section 15. Health and safety regulations.

            <Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
            <P1para>
               <Text>The following subsections of section 13 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974, namely—</Text>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1978/954/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1978/954/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
                  <Pnumber>a</Pnumber>

                  </P3para>
               </P3>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1978/954/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1978/954/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">

                     <Text>subsection (3) (which relates to the bringing and determination of appeals), so far as it applies to an appeal brought under the said subsection (6) against a notice served under the said subsection (5),</Text>

               </P3>
               <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1978/954/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1978/954/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">

                  <P3para>
                     <Text>subsection (8) (which extends references to receptacles in section 13 to include holders for receptacles) so far as it relates to the said subsections (3), (5), (6) and (7),</Text>

            </P1para>
         </P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Planning and Compensation Act 1991 (Commencement No.1 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1991 1 This Order may be cited as the Planning and Compensation Act 1991 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1991. 2 In this Order— “commencement date” means 25th September 1991, and “the 1991 Act” means the Planning and Compensation Act 1991. 3 Subject to article 4, the following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 25th September 1991— section 15; section 17; section 18; section 21; section 22; section 25, in so far as it relates to paragraph 1 of Part I of Schedule 3; section 26; section 29; section 31(1), (4) (so far as that subsection is not yet in force), (5) and (6); section 32, in so far as it relates to paragraphs 8, 9(2)(c), 10(1), 36, 51, 54(1), (3)(a), 56 and 57(1), (2)(b), (3)(b) and (4) of Schedule 7; sections 62 to 69; section 70, except in so far as it reltes to paragraph 32 of Schedule 15; section 80 as it applies in relation to England and Wales, except in so far as it relates to the entries relating to the Planning (Hazardous Substances) Act 1990 in Part I of Schedule 18; section 81; and section 84(6), in so far as it relates to Part II of Schedule 19 (so far as it is not yet in force), Parts III and V of that Schedule and the repeals in Parts I and Iv of that Schedule specified in Schedule 1 to this Order. 4 1 The provison of the 1991 Act mentioned in Part I of Schedule 2 to this Order shall not have effect in a case where any of the following events occurs before the commencement date in relation to the matter specified— a in relation to a compulsory purchase order not made by a Minister, the compulsory purchase order is made; b in relation to a compulsory purchase order made by a Minister, paragraphs 2 and 3 of Schedule 1 to the Acquisition of Land Act 1981 are complied with; c in relation to a purchase notice within the meaning of Chapter I of Part VI of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, the event mentioned in section 137(1) of that Act occurs; and d in relation to a blight notice within the meaning of Chapter II of that Part, the land becomes blighted land, within the meaning of that Chapter. 2 A provision of the 1991 Act mentioned in the first column of an entry in Part II of Schedule 2 to this Order shall not have effect in a case where the date shown against that provision in the second column of the entry is, in relation to that case, before the commencement date. 3 In Part II of that Schedule, except where a contrary intention appears,— a an expression used in an entry in the second column which is also used in the provision of an Act mentioned in the corresponding entry in the first column has the same meaning as in that provision; and b a reference in an entry in the second column to a provision or Part of an Act is a reference to a provision or Part of the Act (other than the 1991 Act) mentioned in the corresponding entry in the first column. PART II REPEAL IN PART <Acronym Expansion="4">IV</Acronym> OF SCHEDULE 19 (SCOTLAND)

The Planning and Compensation Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1991 1 This Order may be cited as the Planning and Compensation Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1991. 2 In this Order— “the 1990 Act” means the Town and Country Planning Act 1990; “the 1991 Act” means the Planning and Compensation Act 1991. 3 Subject to article 5, the following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 2nd January 1992— section 1; section 3, so far as it is not yet in force; section 4, except so far as it relates to breach of condition notices; sections 5 and 6, so far as they are not yet in force; sections 7 to 9; section 11; section 14; section 19, so far as it is not yet in force, except to the extent that it relates to paragraph 4(1) of Schedule 1 to the 1990 Act as it concerns applications for consent to the display of advertisements; sections 23 and 25, so far as they are not yet in force; section 32, so far as it relates to the provisions of Schedule 7 set out in the first column of Schedule 1 to this Order, and, where there is an entry against that provision in the second column of that Schedule, to the extent therein provided; and section 84(6), so far as it gives effect to the repeals in Part I of Schedule 19 specified in Schedule 2 to this Order, except so far as paragraph 4(1) of Schedule 1 to the 1990 Act concerns applications for consent to the display of advertisements. 4 The following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 10th February 1992— section 27, so far as it is not yet in force, section 32, so far as it relates to paragraph 9(2)(a) of Schedule 7, and section 84(6), so far as it gives effect to the repeals in Part I of Schedule 19 to the 1991 Act specified in Schedule 3 to this Order. 5 1 Until 27th July 1992 or the date on which section 10 of the 1991 Act is brought fully into force, if later— a an enforcement notice which relates to a failure to comply with any condition or limitation relating to the carrying out of any operation specified in section 171B(1) of the 1990 Act, in, on, over or under land and subject to which planning permission was granted for the development of that land, may be issued only within the period of four years from the date of the breach; and b nothing in section 171B(3) of the 1990 Act prevents an enforcement notice which relates to a breach of planning control (other than a breach falling within section 171B(1) or (2) of the 1990 Act or paragraph (a) above) being issued where it appears to the local planning authority that the breach occurred after the end of 1963. 2 Subject to paragraph (3), the commencement of paragraph (b) of section 171B(4) shall not permit the taking of further enforcement action in respect of any breach of planning control where, immediately before the commencement of that paragraph, the local planning authority could not have issued an enforcement notice relating to that breach. 3 Paragraph (2) does not apply where any proceedings under the 1990 Act in respect of the breach pursuant to the issue or purported issue of an enforcement notice by the local planning authority have not been finally determined before the commencement of paragraph (b) of section 171B(4). <Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991 (Commencement) Order 1992</dc:title><Made Date="1992-06-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991 (Commencement) Order 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 c. 27">1984 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991 c. 26">1991 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic (Temporary Restrictions) Act 1991.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The 1991 Act shall come into force on 1st July 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a traffic authority has caused notice of intention to make an order under section 14 of the 1984 Act to be published pursuant to Schedule 3 to that Act before 1st July 1992, the traffic authority may make such an order in accordance with the notice and any regulations made under section 16 of that Act shall not apply to the order.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a traffic authority makes an order on or after 1st July 1992 in accordance with a notice so published before that date, paragraph 2 of Schedule 3 to the 1984 Act shall apply to the order as if that paragraph had not been repealed by the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1218/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1218/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The 1991 Act shall not have effect in relation to an order made or notice issued under section 14 of the 1984 Act before 1st July 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of the Schedule to this Order which relate to the matters specified in the second column of that Schedule shall come into force on 1st July 1992 subject to the limitations (if any) specified in the third column of that Schedule.

UK_uksi_1992_1286/6f5812fc71.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement No 4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1992</dc:title><Made Date="1992-06-03"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement No. 4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the 1981 Act” means the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the RTA 1988” means the Road Traffic Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the RTOA 1988” means the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the 1991 Act” means the Road Traffic Act 1991.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of the Schedule to this Order which relate to the matters specified in the second column of that Schedule shall come into force on 1st July 1992 subject to the limitations (if any) specified in the third column of that Schedule.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Without prejudice to section 9(2) of the 1991 Act, a person who immediately before 1st July 1992 is a certifying officer or a public service vehicle examiner appointed under the 1981 Act or an examiner appointed under section 68(1) of the RTA 1988 shall be treated as from that date as if he were an examiner appointed under section 66A of the RTA 1988 for the purpose of carrying out the functions conferred on such an examiner by Part II of that Act, the 1981 Act, the Transport Act 1968<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> and any other enactment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An approval of the Secretary of State under and for the purposes of section 20 of the RTOA 1988 (admissibility of measurement of speed by radar) in force immediately before 1st July 1992 shall have effect in relation to an offence alleged to have been committed on or after that date as if it had been given under and for the purposes of subsection (4) of that section<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 23 of the 1991 Act (speeding offences: admissibility of certain evidence) shall not apply in relation to an offence alleged to have been committed before 1st July 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 24 of the 1991 Act (alternative verdicts) shall not apply in relation to an offence alleged to have been committed before 1st July 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The bringing into force by this Order of a provision of the 1991 Act which relates to the punishment of an offence by way of fine, imprisonment or forfeiture shall not affect the punishment of an offence committed before that provision comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The bringing into force by this Order of a provision of the 1991 Act which relates to the number of penalty points to be attributed to an offence or taken into account on conviction for an offence, shall not affect the number of penalty points to be attributed to an offence or taken into account on conviction for an offence committed before that provision comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person is disqualified under section 34 of the RTOA 1988 for an offence committed before 1st July 1992, the disqualification shall be treated for the purposes of section 29 of that Act (penalty points to be taken into account on conviction) as if it were a disqualification under section 35 of that Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/4" id="article-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person is disqualified under section 34 or 36 of the RTOA 1988 for an offence committed before 1st July 1992, the disqualification shall be treated for the purposes of section 45(5) of that Act (effect of endorsement) as if it were a disqualification under section 35 of that Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5" id="article-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to paragraphs (1) to (4) above, where a person is, after 1st July 1992, convicted of an offence committed before that date—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5/a" id="article-6-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 34 to 37 of the RTOA 1988 (disqualification);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5/b" id="article-6-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 2 to that Act (penalties); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/1286/article/6/5/c" id="article-6-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>

The New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992 1 1 This Order may be cited as the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992. 2 In this Order:— “the 1950 Act” means the Public Utilities and Street Works Act 1950; “the 1980 Act” means the Highways Act 1980; “the 1991 Act” means the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991; “special road authority” has the same meaning as in section 16(4) of the 1980 Act; “special road” has the same meaning as in the 1980 Act; “statutory undertaker” means a person entitled by virtue of a statutory right to carry out street works. 2 1 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 1 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 28th November 1992. 2 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 2 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st January 1993. 3 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 3 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st April 1993. 3 1 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given an advance notice of works for the purposes of section 54 of the 1991 Act. 2 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of the works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have settled a plan and section of the works for the purposes of Schedule 4 to the 1991 Act. 4 An undertaker who has given a notice under section 6(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of starting date of works for the purposes of section 55 of the 1991 Act. 5 An undertaker who has given a notice relating to the execution of emergency works under section 6(5) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of emergency works as required by section 57 of the 1991 Act and the works executed in reliance on such a notice shall be deemed to be emergency works for the purposes of section 57 notwithstanding any of the provisions of section 52 of the 1991 Act. 6 A street authority shall not restrict the execution of street works in a highway by notice under section 58 of the 1991 Act during the twelve months following the completion of substantial road works in any case where the highway authority has on or before 31st December 1992 granted consent to an undertaker to break up or open that highway pursuant to section 156(5) of the 1980 Act. 7 Where a special road authority (within the meaning of section 16(4) of the 1980 Act) has on or before 31st December 1992 granted to a statutory undertaker consent to lay down or erect apparatus in any land comprised in the route of a special road, the consent of the street authority under section 61 of the 1991 Act for placing that apparatus in a protected street shall not be required. 8 The provisions of section 69 of the 1991 Act shall not apply to any street works which are in hand on 1st January 1993 or in respect of which any action required under section 26 of the 1950 Act has been taken before that date. 9 An undertaker shall not be subject to the provisions of section 70 of the 1991 Act if— a the street authority has elected to execute permanent reinstatement in accordance with the provisions of the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act and the undertaker is treated for the purposes of paragraph 5(2) of the said Schedule as having completed his works and such of the permanent reinstatement and making good as by virtue of the 1950 Act he is obliged to execute, provided however that an authority electing to exercise permanent reinstatement as aforesaid may not recover the cost of reinstatement from an undertaker unless the reinstatement has been completed on or before 31st December 1993 and an account has been rendered to the undertaker on or before 31st March 1994; or b the undertaker has begun permanent reinstatement on or before 31st December 1992; or c the street authority and the undertaker have agreed on or before 31st December 1992 that the street authority should execute permanent reinstatement and the reinstatement is executed in accordance with that agreement. 10 The provisions of sections 84(1), (3) and (4) and 85 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in any case where, on or before 31st December 1992, a highway, bridge or transport authority has given to an undertaker a notice of intention to execute works in accordance with paragraph 2(1) of Part I of the Fourth Schedule to the 1950 Act and has accepted that undertaker’s notice given under paragraph 3 of that Schedule as a specification of works and measures necessary to protect the undertaker’s apparatus. 11 Subsections (5) to (8) of section 73 of the 1991 Act shall apply to reinstatements carried out in accordance with section 7 of and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act. 12 Notwithstanding the repeal of the 1950 Act by section 168(2) of and Schedule 9 to the 1991 Act, sections 7, 8, 9 and 10 and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to permanent reinstatements begun by an undertaker on or before 31st December 1992 and to permanent reinstatements carried out by a street authority in the circumstances set out in article 9(a) of this Order. 13 Section 10(1) and 12(4) of the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to street works executed by a transport authority or a sewer authority which were begun on or before 31st December 1992. 14 Section 16 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force in relation to agreements to which that section applies which are made on or before 31st December 1992. 15 Section 8 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force until 31st March 1993 in relation to street works whether or not they were begun before 1st January 1993.
