<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992</dc:title><Made Date="1992-11-27"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order:—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Public Utilities and Street Works Act 1950 c. 39">1950 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Public Utilities and Street Works Act 1950<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Highways Act 1980 c. 66">1980 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Highways Act 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 c. 22">1991 Act</Abbreviation>” means the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“special road authority” has the same meaning as in section 16(4) of the 1980 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“special road” has the same meaning as in the 1980 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“statutory undertaker” means a person entitled by virtue of a statutory right to carry out street works.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 1 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 28th November 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 2 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st January 1993.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 3 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st April 1993.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given an advance notice of works for the purposes of section 54 of the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of the works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have settled a plan and section of the works for the purposes of Schedule 4 to the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An undertaker who has given a notice under section 6(1)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of starting date of works for the purposes of section 55 of the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An undertaker who has given a notice relating to the execution of emergency works under section 6(5) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of emergency works as required by section 57 of the 1991 Act and the works executed in reliance on such a notice shall be deemed to be emergency works for the purposes of section 57 notwithstanding any of the provisions of section 52 of the 1991 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A street authority shall not restrict the execution of street works in a highway by notice under section 58 of the 1991 Act during the twelve months following the completion of substantial road works in any case where the highway authority has on or before 31st December 1992 granted consent to an undertaker to break up or open that highway pursuant to section 156(5) of the 1980 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where a special road authority (within the meaning of section 16(4) of the 1980 Act) has on or before 31st December 1992 granted to a statutory undertaker consent to lay down or erect apparatus in any land comprised in the route of a special road, the consent of the street authority under section 61 of the 1991 Act for placing that apparatus in a protected street shall not be required.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of section 69 of the 1991 Act shall not apply to any street works which are in hand on 1st January 1993 or in respect of which any action required under section 26<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> of the 1950 Act has been taken before that date.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>An undertaker shall not be subject to the provisions of section 70 of the 1991 Act if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/9/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/9/a" id="article-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the street authority has elected to execute permanent reinstatement in accordance with the provisions of the Third Schedule<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> to the 1950 Act and the undertaker is treated for the purposes of paragraph 5(2) of the said Schedule as having completed his works and such of the permanent reinstatement and making good as by virtue of the 1950 Act he is obliged to execute, provided however that an authority electing to exercise permanent reinstatement as aforesaid may not recover the cost of reinstatement from an undertaker unless the reinstatement has been completed on or before 31st December 1993 and an account has been rendered to the undertaker on or before 31st March 1994; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/9/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/9/b" id="article-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the undertaker has begun permanent reinstatement on or before 31st December 1992; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/9/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/9/c" id="article-9-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the street authority and the undertaker have agreed on or before 31st December 1992 that the street authority should execute permanent reinstatement and the reinstatement is executed in accordance with that agreement.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of sections 84(1), (3) and (4) and 85 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in any case where, on or before 31st December 1992, a highway, bridge or transport authority has given to an undertaker a notice of intention to execute works in accordance with paragraph 2(1) of Part I of the Fourth Schedule to the 1950 Act and has accepted that undertaker’s notice given under paragraph 3 of that Schedule as a specification of works and measures necessary to protect the undertaker’s apparatus.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subsections (5) to (8) of section 73 of the 1991 Act shall apply to reinstatements carried out in accordance with section 7 of and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the repeal of the 1950 Act by section 168(2) of and Schedule 9 to the 1991 Act, sections 7, 8, 9 and 10<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to permanent reinstatements begun by an undertaker on or before 31st December 1992 and to permanent reinstatements carried out by a street authority in the circumstances set out in article 9(a) of this Order.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/13" id="article-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 10(1) and 12(4) of the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to street works executed by a transport authority or a sewer authority which were begun on or before 31st December 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/14" id="article-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 16 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force in relation to agreements to which that section applies which are made on or before 31st December 1992.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1992/2984/article/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1992/2984/article/15" id="article-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 8 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force until 31st March 1993 in relation to street works whether or not they were begun before 1st January 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992 1 1 This Order may be cited as the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 1992. 2 In this Order:— “the 1950 Act” means the Public Utilities and Street Works Act 1950; “the 1980 Act” means the Highways Act 1980; “the 1991 Act” means the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991; “special road authority” has the same meaning as in section 16(4) of the 1980 Act; “special road” has the same meaning as in the 1980 Act; “statutory undertaker” means a person entitled by virtue of a statutory right to carry out street works. 2 1 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 1 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 28th November 1992. 2 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 2 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st January 1993. 3 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 3 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st April 1993. 3 1 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given an advance notice of works for the purposes of section 54 of the 1991 Act. 2 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of the works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have settled a plan and section of the works for the purposes of Schedule 4 to the 1991 Act. 4 An undertaker who has given a notice under section 6(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of starting date of works for the purposes of section 55 of the 1991 Act. 5 An undertaker who has given a notice relating to the execution of emergency works under section 6(5) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of emergency works as required by section 57 of the 1991 Act and the works executed in reliance on such a notice shall be deemed to be emergency works for the purposes of section 57 notwithstanding any of the provisions of section 52 of the 1991 Act. 6 A street authority shall not restrict the execution of street works in a highway by notice under section 58 of the 1991 Act during the twelve months following the completion of substantial road works in any case where the highway authority has on or before 31st December 1992 granted consent to an undertaker to break up or open that highway pursuant to section 156(5) of the 1980 Act. 7 Where a special road authority (within the meaning of section 16(4) of the 1980 Act) has on or before 31st December 1992 granted to a statutory undertaker consent to lay down or erect apparatus in any land comprised in the route of a special road, the consent of the street authority under section 61 of the 1991 Act for placing that apparatus in a protected street shall not be required. 8 The provisions of section 69 of the 1991 Act shall not apply to any street works which are in hand on 1st January 1993 or in respect of which any action required under section 26 of the 1950 Act has been taken before that date. 9 An undertaker shall not be subject to the provisions of section 70 of the 1991 Act if— a the street authority has elected to execute permanent reinstatement in accordance with the provisions of the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act and the undertaker is treated for the purposes of paragraph 5(2) of the said Schedule as having completed his works and such of the permanent reinstatement and making good as by virtue of the 1950 Act he is obliged to execute, provided however that an authority electing to exercise permanent reinstatement as aforesaid may not recover the cost of reinstatement from an undertaker unless the reinstatement has been completed on or before 31st December 1993 and an account has been rendered to the undertaker on or before 31st March 1994; or b the undertaker has begun permanent reinstatement on or before 31st December 1992; or c the street authority and the undertaker have agreed on or before 31st December 1992 that the street authority should execute permanent reinstatement and the reinstatement is executed in accordance with that agreement. 10 The provisions of sections 84(1), (3) and (4) and 85 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in any case where, on or before 31st December 1992, a highway, bridge or transport authority has given to an undertaker a notice of intention to execute works in accordance with paragraph 2(1) of Part I of the Fourth Schedule to the 1950 Act and has accepted that undertaker’s notice given under paragraph 3 of that Schedule as a specification of works and measures necessary to protect the undertaker’s apparatus. 11 Subsections (5) to (8) of section 73 of the 1991 Act shall apply to reinstatements carried out in accordance with section 7 of and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act. 12 Notwithstanding the repeal of the 1950 Act by section 168(2) of and Schedule 9 to the 1991 Act, sections 7, 8, 9 and 10 and the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to permanent reinstatements begun by an undertaker on or before 31st December 1992 and to permanent reinstatements carried out by a street authority in the circumstances set out in article 9(a) of this Order. 13 Section 10(1) and 12(4) of the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to street works executed by a transport authority or a sewer authority which were begun on or before 31st December 1992. 14 Section 16 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force in relation to agreements to which that section applies which are made on or before 31st December 1992. 15 Section 8 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force until 31st March 1993 in relation to street works whether or not they were begun before 1st January 1993. (Scotland) Act 1984; “the 1991 Act” means the New Roads and Street Works Act 1991; “sewer authority” has the same meaning as in section 39(1) of the 1950 Act; “special road” has the same meaning as in section 151(1) of the 1984 Act; “special road authority” has the same meaning as in section 7(4) of the 1984 Act; “statutory undertaker” means an undertaker who is entitled to carry out road works by virtue of a statutory right. 2 1 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 1 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 30th November 1992. 2 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 2 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st January 1993. 3 The provisions of the 1991 Act specified in the first column of Schedule 3 to this Order (which relates to the matters specified in the second column thereof) shall come into force on 1st April 1993. 3 1 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992, shall be deemed to have given an advance notice of works for the purposes of section 113 of the 1991 Act. 2 An undertaker who has submitted a plan and section of works under section 3(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have settled a plan and section of the works for the purposes of Schedule 6 to the 1991 Act. 4 An undertaker who has given a notice under section 6(1) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of starting date of works for the purposes of section 114 of the 1991 Act. 5 An undertaker who has given a notice relating to the execution of emergency works under section 6(5) of the 1950 Act on or before 31st December 1992 shall be deemed to have given a notice of emergency works under section 116 of the 1991 Act and the works executed in reliance on such a notice shall be deemed to be emergency works for the purposes of section 116 notwithstanding any of the provisions of section 111 of the 1991 Act. 6 A road works authority shall not restrict the execution of road works in a road by notice under section 117 of the 1991 Act during the twelve months following the completion of substantial works carried out for road purposes in any case where the roads authority has on or before 31st December 1992 granted consent to an undertaker to break up or open that road under section 28(4) of the 1950 Act. 7 Where a special road authority has on or before 31st December 1992 granted to a statutory undertaker consent to lay down or erect apparatus in any land comprised in the route of a special road, the consent of the road works authority under section 120 of the 1991 Act for the placing of that apparatus in a protected road shall not be required. 8 The provisions of section 128 of the 1991 Act shall not apply to any road works which are in hand on 1st January 1993 or in respect of which any action required under section 26 of the 1950 Act has been taken before that date. 9 An undertaker shall not be subject to the provisions of section 129 of the 1991 Act if— a the road works authority has elected to execute permanent reinstatement in accordance with the provisions of the Third Schedule to the 1950 Act and the undertaker is treated for the purposes of paragraph 5(2) of that Schedule as having completed his works and such of the permanent reinstatement and making good as by virtue of the 1950 Act he is obliged to execute, provided that an authority electing to execute permanent reinstatement as aforesaid may not recover the cost of reinstatement from an undertaker unless the reinstatement has been completed on or before 31st December 1993 and an account has been rendered to the undertaker on or before 31st March 1994; or b the undertaker has begun permanent reinstatement on or before 31st December 1992; or c the road works authority and the undertaker have agreed on or before 31st December 1992 that the road works authority should execute permanent reinstatement and the reinstatement is executed in accordance with that agreement. 10 The provisions of sections 143(1), (3) and (4) and 144 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in any case where, on or before 31st December 1992, a roads, bridge or transport authority have given to an undertaker a notice of intention to execute works in accordance with paragraph 2(1) of Part I of the Fourth Schedule to the 1950 Act and has accepted that undertaker’s notice given under paragraph 3 of that Schedule as a specification of works and measures necessary to protect the undertaker’s apparatus. 11 Subsections (5) to (8) of section 132 of the 1991 Act shall apply to reinstatements carried out in accordance with section 7 of, and the Third Schedule to, the 1950 Act. 12 Notwithstanding the repeal of the 1950 Act by section 168(2) of, and Schedule 9 to, the 1991 Act, sections 7, 8, 9 and 10 of, and the Third Schedule to, the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to permanent reinstatements begun by an undertaker on or before 31st December 1992 and to permanent reinstatements carried out by a road works authority in the circumstances set out in article 9(a) of this Order. 13 Sections 10(1) and 12(4) of the 1950 Act shall continue to apply to road works executed by a transport authority or a sewer authority which were begun on or before 31st December 1992. 14 Section 16 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force in relation to agreements to which that section applies which are made on or before 31st December 1992. 15 Section 8 of the 1950 Act shall continue in force until 31st March 1993 in relation to road works whether or not they were begun before 1st January 1993. <Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993</dc:title><Made Date="1993-06-10"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1" id="article-1">

<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 c. 27">1984 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Act 1991 c. 40">1991 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Act 1991; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“vehicle” has the meaning given by section 99(5) of the 1984 Act.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Order, a London borough is a relevant London borough if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/a" id="article-1-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection (1) of section 64 of the 1991 Act is in force in respect of that London borough,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/b" id="article-1-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsections (4) and (6) of section 67 of the 1991 Act are for the time being in force for the purposes of the subsections thereby inserted in relation to vehicles found in that London borough, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/3/c" id="article-1-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection (2)(b) of section 68 of the 1991 Act is for the time being in force for the purposes of the subsection thereby inserted in relation to the council of that London borough.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/1/4" id="article-1-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Order, the City of London shall be treated as if were a London borough and the Common Council be treated as if it were the council of a London borough.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 42;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 66(7);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/e" id="article-2-e">

<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/f" id="article-2-f">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/h" id="article-2-h">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/2/g" id="article-2-g">

</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993 in respect of the London borough of Wandsworth only—</Text>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/c" id="article-3-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 66, to the extent that it is not brought into force by article 2 of this Order;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/d" id="article-3-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>

</P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/e" id="article-3-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/1/f" id="article-3-1-f">

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until subsection (1) of section 64 of the 1991 Act is fully in force, section 46 of the 1984 Act as amended by section 64 of the 1991 Act shall have effect as if “Greater London” meant so much of Greater London as consists of relevant London boroughs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/4" id="article-4">

<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 67 of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993 except that subsections (4) and (6) of that section shall so come into force only for the purpose of the application of the subsections thereby inserted in relation to vehicles found in the London borough of Wandsworth.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until subsections (4) and (6) of section 67 of the 1991 Act are fully in force, section 101 of the 1984 Act, as amended by section 67 of the 1991 Act, shall have effect as if “Greater London”, wherever it occurs, meant so much of Greater London as consists of relevant London boroughs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 68 of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 5th July 1993 except that subsections (2)(b) of that section shall so come into force only for the purpose of the application of the subsection thereby inserted in relation to the council of the London borough of Wandsworth.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until subsection (2)(b) of section 68 of the 1991 Act is fully in force, section 102 of the 1984 Act as amended by section 68 of the 1991 Act, shall have effect as if–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/a" id="article-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“London authority” meant the council of a relevant London borough, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/5/2/b" id="article-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (8), after the words “local authority” there were inserted the words “or from a parking place which is designated under section 6 of this Act but is not within the area of a relevant London borough as defined in The Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to a vehicle that is stationary in a designated parking place immediately before 5th July 1993, section 66(2) of the 1991 Act shall have effect for so long as it remains in that parking place as if the words “on or after 5th July 1993” were inserted after—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/1461/article/6/1/a" id="article-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “left” in paragraph (a),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>

The Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993 1 This Order may be cited as the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993. 2 In this Order– “the Act” means the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993. 3 1 This Article has effect subject to the provisions of Articles 4 to 10 below. 2 The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 1 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th August 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 3 The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th September 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose. 4 All provisions of the Act insofar as they are not in force immediately before 1st October 1993, with the exception of those mentioned in paragraph (5) of this Article, shall come into force on 1st October 1993. 5 Sections 30, 33, 34 and 35 of the Act shall come into force on 1st January 1994. 4 1 Each of the following provisions shall apply only in relation to criminal proceedings which are commenced on or after the date when that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:– a any provision in Part II of the Act, except sections 28, 29, 40(1), 42(1) and 43; b any provision in Schedule 4 to the Act; c in Schedule 5 to the Act, any provision in any of the sub-paragraphs of paragraph 1, except sub-paragraphs (1), (5), (8), (9) to (29), (35) and (38); and d in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, any repeal which is consequential upon any of the above provisions; 2 For the purposes of paragraph (1) of this Article, criminal proceedings are commenced– a in summary proceedings, on the date of the first calling of the case; and b in solemn proceedings, on the date on whichever of the following first occurs:– i the grant of a warrant to arrest and commit; ii the intimation of a petition; and iii the service of an indictment. 5 Each of the following provisions shall apply only in a case where the trial has commenced on or after the date on which that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:– a section 40(1) of the Act; and b in Schedule 5 to the Act, sub-paragraph (5) of paragraph 1, and, for the purposes of this Article and Article 7 below, a trial shall be taken to commence when the oath is administered to the jury. 6 Without prejudice to section 17(2) of the Interpretation Act 1978(), insofar as anything done under or by virtue of section 274 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975(), as in force immediately before 1st October 1993, could have been done under or by virtue of the new provision, it shall have effect as if done under or by virtue of the new provision; and, for the purposes of this Article, the “new provision” means section 274 of that Act, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act. 7 Section 275 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act, shall apply in respect of any request made on or after 1st October 1993 for a transcript to be made of the proceedings at any trial, whether that trial commenced before or after that date. 8 Section 28 of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who is arrested or is detained under section 2(1) of the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980() on or after 1st October 1993. 9 The following provisions of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st September 1993, namely:– a section 43 of the Act; and b in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, the repeal of paragraph 12 of Schedule 3 to the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980. 10 The following provisions shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st October 1993, namely:– a section 42(1) of the Act; and b in Schedule 5 to the Act, paragraph 1(9) to (26), (29) and (35). <Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993</dc:title><Made Date="1993-08-16"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 Commencement, Transitional Provisions and Savings Order 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order–</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993 c. 9">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Prisoners and Criminal Proceedings (Scotland) Act 1993.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Article has effect subject to the provisions of Articles 4 to 10 below.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 1 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th August 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the Act which are specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to this Order shall, insofar as they are not then in force, come into force on 18th September 1993 but, where a particular purpose in relation to any such provision is specified in column 2 of that Schedule, that provision shall come into force on that day only for that purpose.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>All provisions of the Act insofar as they are not in force immediately before 1st October 1993, with the exception of those mentioned in paragraph (5) of this Article, shall come into force on 1st October 1993.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/3/5" id="article-3-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sections 30, 33, 34 and 35 of the Act shall come into force on 1st January 1994.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Each of the following provisions shall apply only in relation to criminal proceedings which are commenced on or after the date when that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any provision in Part II of the Act, except sections 28, 29, 40(1), 42(1) and 43;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any provision in Schedule 4 to the Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, any provision in any of the sub-paragraphs of paragraph 1, except sub-paragraphs (1), (5), (8), (9) to (29), (35) and (38); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/1/d" id="article-4-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, any repeal which is consequential upon any of the above provisions;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraph (1) of this Article, criminal proceedings are commenced–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in summary proceedings, on the date of the first calling of the case; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in solemn proceedings, on the date on whichever of the following first occurs:–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/i" id="article-4-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the grant of a warrant to arrest and commit;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/ii" id="article-4-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the intimation of a petition; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/4/2/b/iii" id="article-4-2-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the service of an indictment.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Each of the following provisions shall apply only in a case where the trial has commenced on or after the date on which that provision comes into force, for all purposes, by virtue of this Order, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 40(1) of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, sub-paragraph (5) of paragraph 1,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and, for the purposes of this Article and Article 7 below, a trial shall be taken to commence when the oath is administered to the jury.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Without prejudice to section 17(2) of the Interpretation Act 1978(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>), insofar as anything done under or by virtue of section 274 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>), as in force immediately before 1st October 1993, could have been done under or by virtue of the new provision, it shall have effect as if done under or by virtue of the new provision; and, for the purposes of this Article, the “new provision” means section 274 of that Act, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 275 of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1975, as substituted by sub-paragraph (27) of paragraph 1 of Schedule 5 to the Act, shall apply in respect of any request made on or after 1st October 1993 for a transcript to be made of the proceedings at any trial, whether that trial commenced before or after that date.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 28 of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who is arrested or is detained under section 2(1) of the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>) on or after 1st October 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st September 1993, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/a" id="article-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 43 of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/9/b" id="article-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part I of Schedule 7 to the Act, the repeal of paragraph 12 of Schedule 3 to the Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 1980.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions shall apply only in the case of a person who has been convicted on or after 1st October 1993, namely:–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/a" id="article-10-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 42(1) of the Act; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2050/article/10/b" id="article-10-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 5 to the Act, paragraph 1(9) to (26), (29) and (35).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Road Traffic Act 1991(Commencement No. 7 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993</dc:title><Made Date="1993-09-10"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 7 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Act 1991 c. 40">1991 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Act 1991; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“vehicle” has the meaning given by section 99(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Road Traffic Act 1991 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> is amended as follows:—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in article 1(4) after the word “if” where it first occurs there is inserted the word “it”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in article 6—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/b/i" id="article-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) after the words “parking place” where those words first occur there are inserted the words “in the London borough of Wandsworth”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/2/b/ii" id="article-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) for the words “has been removed pursuant to any enactment” there are substituted the words “found in the London borough of Wandsworth has pursuant to any enactment been removed”.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 4th October 1993 in respect of the London boroughs of Bromley, Hammersmith and Fulham and Lewisham—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 64, to the extent that it is not already in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 65;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 66, to the extent that it is not already in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 69;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/e" id="article-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 81, to the extent necessary for bringing into force the provisions of Schedule 7 brought into force by this article; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/3/f" id="article-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 5 of Schedule 7, to the extent that that paragraph is not already in force.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subsections (4) and (6) of section 67 of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 4th October 1993 for the purpose of the application of the subsections thereby inserted in relation to vehicles found in the London boroughs of Bromley, Hammersmith and Fulham and Lewisham.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subsection (2)(b) of section 68 of the 1991 Act shall come into force on 4th October 1993 for the purpose of the application of the subsection thereby inserted in relation to the councils of the London boroughs of Bromley, Hammersmith and Fulham and Lewisham.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to a vehicle that is stationary in a designated parking place in the London borough of Bromley, Hammersmith and Fulham or Lewisham immediately before 4th October 1993, section 66(2) of the 1991 Act shall have effect for so long as it remains in that parking place as if the words “on or after 4th October 1993” were inserted after—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1/a" id="article-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “left” in paragraph (a),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1/b" id="article-6-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “payable” in paragraph (b), and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/1/c" id="article-6-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “has” in paragraph (c).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2229/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a vehicle found in the London borough of Bromley, Hammersmith and Fulham or Lewisham has pursuant to any enactment been removed before 4th October 1993, sections 67 and 68 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in relation to that removal or to any storage or disposal of the vehicle as a consequence of that removal.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2803/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2803/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">

<P2para>
<Text>In relation to a vehicle that is stationary in a designated parking place in the London borough of Camden, Hackney or Hounslow immediately before 6th December 1993, section 66(2) of the 1991 Act shall have effect for so long as it remains in that parking place as if the words “on or after 6th December 1993” were inserted after—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/1/a" id="article-5-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “left” in paragraph (a) of section 66(2),</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/1/b" id="article-5-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “payable” in paragraph (b) of that subsection, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/1/c" id="article-5-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the word “has” in paragraph (c) of that subsection.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/2803/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a vehicle found in the London borough of Camden, Hackney or Hounslow has pursuant to any enactment been removed before 6th December 1993, sections 67 and 68 of the 1991 Act shall not apply in relation to that removal or to any storage or disposal of the vehicle as a consequence of that removal.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">

<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Local Government Finance Act 1992 (Commencement No.8 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1993.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Finance Act 1992 c. 14">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Finance Act 1992.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act shall, so far as not then in force, come into force on 1st April 1993—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 99(2) and 111;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 11, paragraphs 29(a), 30, 32 to 36 and 38(b) and (e);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 13, paragraphs 2, 9, 35, 37(2), 38, 40, 44(a), (b) and (d), 53 to 56 and 93; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 14, the repeals listed in the Schedule to this Order.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The repeal by this Order of section 28B of the Registration of Births, Deaths and Marriages (Scotland) Act 1965(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>) shall not affect the operation of that section, or of regulations made under it, in relation to any death occurring before 1st April 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The repeal by this Order of subsection (2A) of section 18 of the Abolition of Domestic Rates Etc. (Scotland) Act 1987(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>) shall not affect the operation of that subsection in relation to any death occurring before 1st April 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Nothing in this Order shall affect the operation of—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 110 and 118(1)(b) of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973(<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1993/575/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1993/575/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 5 to the Abolition of Domestic Rates Etc. (Scotland) Act 1987;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>in relation to any financial year beginning before 1st April 1993.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: The provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 set out in paragraph (3) below shall come into force on 1st May 1994, save for the purposes of their application to the following activities— a

UK_uksi_1994_1096/0d4e92754b.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Environmental Protection Act 1990 (Commencement No. 15) Order 1994</dc:title><Made Date="1994-04-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Environmental Protection Act 1990 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 15) Order 1994.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“appropriate date”, in relation to an appeal, means the date on which—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the period for appealing expires without an appeal being made; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Bany appeal is withdrawn or finally determined;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“authorisation” has the meaning given in section 1(9) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“existing process” and “prescribed date” have the same meaning as in Schedule 3 to the Environmental Protection (Prescribed Processes and Substances) Regulations 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant date”, in relation to an application for a licence, means the date on which the licence applied for is grantedor, if the application is (or is deemed to be) rejected, the date on which</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the period for appealing expires without an appeal being made; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any appeal is withdrawn or finally determined;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList><Text>and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“scrap metal” has the same meaning as in the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 1964<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 shall come into force on 1st May 1994</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 54 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 58 and 59;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 60 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 64 to 67 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 73 and 74 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(1) insofar as it relates to paragraph 27 of Schedule 15;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(2) insofar as it relates to the following repeals in Part II of Schedule 16—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the repeal of section 1 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in relation to Scotland only, the repeal of section 11 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 set out in paragraph (3) below shall come into force on 1st May 1994, save for the purposes of their application to the following activities—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity which on that date is the subject of a pending application for a disposal licence under Part I of the Controlof Pollution Act 1974;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity in respect of which on that date an appeal in pursuance of section 10(1)(d) of the Control of Pollution Act 1974 (appeals to Secretary of State where a disposal licence is revoked) is pending or where the period for making such an appealhas not expired;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity which involves treating, keeping or disposing of scrap metal or motor vehicles which are to bedismantled;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d" id="article-2-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/i" id="article-2-2-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which on that date is the subject of a disposal licence under Part I of the Control of Pollution Act 1974;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/ii" id="article-2-2-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which is or forms part of an existing process for which no authorisation has been granted; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/iii" id="article-2-2-d-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to which, if an authorisation were granted, section 33(1)(a) and (b) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 would not apply by virtue of the Waste Management Licensing Regulations 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions referred to in paragraph (2) are—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 33 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 35 to 40 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 42 and 43 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 44;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 57;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(1) insofar as it relates to paragraph 26 of Schedule 15;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(2) insofar as it relates to the following repeals in Part II of Schedule 16—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the repeal of sections 3 to 10, 18 and 27 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3) below, the provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 set outin article 2(3) (“the relevant provisions”) shall come into force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of their application to an activity falling within article 2(2)(a), on the day immediately following therelevant date in relation to the application in question;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of their application to an activity falling within article 2(2)(b), on the day immediately followingthe appropriate date in relation to the appeal in question.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (3)</Text>
</P2para>
<P2para>
<Text>below, where an activity falls within article 2(2)(c) (whether or not it also falls withinarticle 2(2)(a) or (b)), the relevant provisions shall come into force for the purposes of their application to that activity—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if on 1st October 1994 that activity is the subject of a pending application for a disposal licence under Part I of theControl of Pollution Act 1974, on the day immediately following the relevant date in relation to the application in question;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if on 1st October 1994 an appeal in pursuance of section 10(1)(d) of the Control of Pollution Act 1974 (appeals to Secretary of State where a disposal licence is revoked) is pending in respect of that activity or the period for making suchan appeal has not expired, on the day immediately following the appropriate date in relation to that appeal;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/c" id="article-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any other case, on 1st October 1994.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where an activity falls within article 2(2)(d) (whether or not it also falls within any other sub-paragraph of article 2(2)), the relevant provisions shall come into force for the purposes of their applicaton to that activity on the day immediatelyfollowing the prescribed date in relation to the process in question.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
