<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“appropriate date”, in relation to an appeal, means the date on which—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the period for appealing expires without an appeal being made; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Bany appeal is withdrawn or finally determined;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“authorisation” has the meaning given in section 1(9) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“existing process” and “prescribed date” have the same meaning as in Schedule 3 to the Environmental Protection (Prescribed Processes and Substances) Regulations 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant date”, in relation to an application for a licence, means the date on which the licence applied for is grantedor, if the application is (or is deemed to be) rejected, the date on which</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the period for appealing expires without an appeal being made; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>any appeal is withdrawn or finally determined;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList><Text>and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“scrap metal” has the same meaning as in the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 1964<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 shall come into force on 1st May 1994</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 54 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 58 and 59;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 60 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 64 to 67 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 73 and 74 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(1) insofar as it relates to paragraph 27 of Schedule 15;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(2) insofar as it relates to the following repeals in Part II of Schedule 16—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the repeal of section 1 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in relation to Scotland only, the repeal of section 11 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 set out in paragraph (3) below shall come into force on 1st May 1994, save for the purposes of their application to the following activities—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity which on that date is the subject of a pending application for a disposal licence under Part I of the Controlof Pollution Act 1974;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity in respect of which on that date an appeal in pursuance of section 10(1)(d) of the Control of Pollution Act 1974 (appeals to Secretary of State where a disposal licence is revoked) is pending or where the period for making such an appealhas not expired;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity which involves treating, keeping or disposing of scrap metal or motor vehicles which are to bedismantled;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d" id="article-2-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an activity—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/i" id="article-2-2-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which on that date is the subject of a disposal licence under Part I of the Control of Pollution Act 1974;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/ii" id="article-2-2-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which is or forms part of an existing process for which no authorisation has been granted; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/2/d/iii" id="article-2-2-d-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to which, if an authorisation were granted, section 33(1)(a) and (b) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 would not apply by virtue of the Waste Management Licensing Regulations 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions referred to in paragraph (2) are—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 33 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 35 to 40 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 42 and 43 (insofar as not already in force);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 44;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 57;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(1) insofar as it relates to paragraph 26 of Schedule 15;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 162(2) insofar as it relates to the following repeals in Part II of Schedule 16—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>the repeal of sections 3 to 10, 18 and 27 of the Control of Pollution Act 1974.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3) below, the provisions of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 set outin article 2(3) (“the relevant provisions”) shall come into force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of their application to an activity falling within article 2(2)(a), on the day immediately following therelevant date in relation to the application in question;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of their application to an activity falling within article 2(2)(b), on the day immediately followingthe appropriate date in relation to the appeal in question.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (3)</Text>
</P2para>
<P2para>
<Text>below, where an activity falls within article 2(2)(c) (whether or not it also falls withinarticle 2(2)(a) or (b)), the relevant provisions shall come into force for the purposes of their application to that activity—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if on 1st October 1994 that activity is the subject of a pending application for a disposal licence under Part I of theControl of Pollution Act 1974, on the day immediately following the relevant date in relation to the application in question;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if on 1st October 1994 an appeal in pursuance of section 10(1)(d) of the Control of Pollution Act 1974 (appeals to Secretary of State where a disposal licence is revoked) is pending in respect of that activity or the period for making suchan appeal has not expired, on the day immediately following the appropriate date in relation to that appeal;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/2/c" id="article-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any other case, on 1st October 1994.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1096/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where an activity falls within article 2(2)(d) (whether or not it also falls within any other sub-paragraph of article 2(2)), the relevant provisions shall come into force for the purposes of their applicaton to that activity on the day immediatelyfollowing the prescribed date in relation to the process in question.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

Act” means the Local Government Act 1972; “the 1990 Act” means the Town and Country Planning Act 1990; “the 1994 Act” means the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994; and “old authority” means a county or district council which will cease to exist as a result of the 1994 Act. 3 1 Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3) the provisions of Part I of, and Schedule 2 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 1 to this Order shall come into force on 3rd April 1995. 2 The provisions of section 1(5), (6) and (8) of the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect for the interpretation of the 1972 Act only to such extent as provisions of that Act fall to be applied in consequence of the bringing into force of provisions of the 1994 Act. 3 The provisions of sections 270(1) and 245A of the 1972 Act in force immediately prior to the commencement of sections 1(5), (6) and (8), and 5 of the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the administration of local government in Wales before 1st April 1996. 4 1 Subject to paragraphs (2) to (6) the provisions of Part II of, and Schedules 6, 7 and 10 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 2 to this Order shall come into force on 3rd April 1995. 2 Until 1st April 1996 the provisions of section 18(1) to (6) of the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the purpose of any order made under section 2(1B) of the 1990 Act or, as the case may be, paragraph 3A(1) of Schedule 17 to the 1972 Act. 3 The provisions of section 1 of the 1990 Act in force immediately prior to the commencement of section 18(1) to (6) of the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the exercise of local planning authority functions by each old authority. 4 The provisions of paragraph 21A of Schedule 17 to the 1972 Act in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 12 of Schedule 6 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the discharge of planning and countryside functions in national parks in Wales before 1st April 1996. 5 The provisions of paragraph 1 of Schedule 7 to the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the interpretation of paragraph 18 of Schedule 17 to the 1994 Act and only to such extent as will allow action to be taken thereunder for the purpose of identifying the relevant highway authority in readiness for its assumption of full highway authority functions on 1st April 1996. 6 The provisions of section 1 of the Highways Act 1980 in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 1 of Schedule 7 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the discharge of local highway authority functions in Wales before 1st April 1996. 5 The provisions of Part III of the 1994 Act shall come into force on 3rd April 1995. 6 1 Subject to paragraphs (2) to (5) the provisions of Part IV of, and Schedule 12 to, the 1994 Act shall come into force on 3rd April 1995. 2 The provisions of section 1(2) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 in force immediately prior to the commencement of section 35 of the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect so far as is necessary for the purposes of section 35(3) of the 1994 Act. 3 Nothing in paragraph 1 of Schedule 12 to the 1994 Act shall affect the operation of section 148 of the 1972 Act in relation to an old authority. 4 Nothing in paragraph 2 of Schedule 12 to the 1994 Act shall affect the operation of Part VI of the Local Government Finance Act 1988 in relation to an old authority. 5 Nothing in paragraphs 4, 5, 6 and 8 of Schedule 12 shall affect the operation of sections 32, 33, 35 and 62 of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 in relation to an old authority. 7 The provisions of Part V of come into force on 3rd April 1995. 9 1 Subject to paragraphs (2) to (5) the provisions of Part VII of, and Schedules 15, 16, 17 and 18 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 5 to this Order 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to an old authority. 3 The provisions of section 20(1) of the Local Government, Planning and Land Act 1980 in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 57(3) of Schedule 16 shall continue to have effect in relation to an old authority. 4 Until 1st April 1996 the provisions of paragraph 82(1), (2) and (3) of Schedule 16 to before 1st April 1996. <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3) the provisions of Part I of, and Schedule 2 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 1 to this Order shall come into force on 3rd April 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 1(5), (6) and (8) of the 1994 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> brought into force by this Order shall have effect for the interpretation of the 1972 Act only to such extent as provisions of that Act fall to be applied in consequence of the bringing into force of provisions of the 1994 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of sections 270(1) and 245A of the 1972 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> in force immediately prior to the commencement of sections 1(5), (6) and (8), and 5 of the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the administration of local government in Wales before 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) to (6) the provisions of Part II of, and Schedules 6, 7 and 10 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 2 to this Order shall come into force on 3rd April 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until 1st April 1996 the provisions of section 18(1) to (6) of the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the purpose of any order made under section 2(1B) of the 1990 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> or, as the case may be, paragraph 3A(1) of Schedule 17 to the 1972 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 1 of the 1990 Act in force immediately prior to the commencement of section 18(1) to (6) of the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the exercise of local planning authority functions by each old authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/4/4" id="article-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of paragraph 21A of Schedule 17 to the 1972 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 12 of Schedule 6 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the discharge of planning and countryside functions in national parks in Wales before 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/4/5" id="article-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of paragraph 1 of Schedule 7 to the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the interpretation of paragraph 18 of Schedule 17 to the 1994 Act and only to such extent as will allow action to be taken thereunder for the purpose of identifying the relevant highway authority in readiness for its assumption of full highway authority functions on 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/4/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/4/6" id="article-4-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 1 of the Highways Act 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 1 of Schedule 7 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to the discharge of local highway authority functions in Wales before 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of Part III of the 1994 Act shall come into force on 3rd April 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) to (5) the provisions of Part IV of, and Schedule 12 to, the 1994 Act shall come into force on 3rd April 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 1(2) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> in force immediately prior to the commencement of section 35 of the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect so far as is necessary for the purposes of section 35(3) of the 1994 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in paragraph 1 of Schedule 12 to the 1994 Act shall affect the operation of section 148 of the 1972 Act in relation to an old authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/6/4" id="article-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in paragraph 2 of Schedule 12 to the 1994 Act shall affect the operation of Part VI of the Local Government Finance Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/> in relation to an old authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/6/5" id="article-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in paragraphs 4, 5, 6 and 8 of Schedule 12 shall affect the operation of sections 32, 33, 35 and 62 of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 in relation to an old authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of Part V of the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 3 to this Order shall come into force on 3rd April 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of Part VI of the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 4 to this Order shall come into force on 3rd April 1995.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/9/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/9/1" id="article-9-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) to (5) the provisions of Part VII of, and Schedules 15, 16, 17 and 18 to, the 1994 Act which are specified in Schedule 5 to this Order shall come into force on 3rd April 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/9/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/9/2" id="article-9-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of sections 74, 101 and 249 of the 1972 Act in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraphs 20, 26 and 55 of Schedule 15 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to an old authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/9/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/9/3" id="article-9-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of section 20(1) of the Local Government, Planning and Land Act 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 57(3) of Schedule 16 shall continue to have effect in relation to an old authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/9/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/9/4" id="article-9-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until 1st April 1996 the provisions of paragraph 82(1), (2) and (3) of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act brought into force by this Order shall have effect only for the purpose of any order made under section 4A of the Coroners Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1995/852/article/9/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1995/852/article/9/5" id="article-9-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions of sections 1, 2 and 4 of the Coroners Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> in force immediately prior to the commencement of paragraph 82(1), (2), (3) and (4) of Schedule 16 to the 1994 Act shall continue to have effect in relation to coroners in Wales before 1st April 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1943/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1943/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Transport Act 1982 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 7 and Transitional Provisions) Order 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1943/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1943/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this Order, the appointed day is 1st August 1996.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1943/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1943/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to article 3 below, section 18 of the Transport Act 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall come into force on the appointed day.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1943/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1943/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>During the period beginning with the appointed day and ending immediately before the day on which section 8 of the Transport Act 1982 comes into force, section 63A(3)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> shall have effect with the omission of the words “or by the prescribed testing authority”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Environment Act 1995 (Commencement No. 8 and Saving Provisions) Order 1996</dc:title><Made Date="1996-11-20"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Environment Act 1995 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 8 and Saving Provisions) Order 1996.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 120(1) of the Environment Act 1995 shall come into force on 21st November 1996 in so far as it relates to paragraphs 142, 143, 169, 170 and 183 of Schedule 22 in so far as the amendments made by those provisions confer any power to make regulations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to article 4, the following provisions of the Environment Act 1995 shall come into force on 31st December 1996—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 120(1) in so far as it relates to paragraphs 142, 143, 169, 170 and 183 of Schedule 22 in so far as those paragraphs are not already in force; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 120(3) in so far as it relates to the repeals made in Schedule 24 in relation to sections 91 and 190(1) of the Water Resources Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Nothing in this Order shall affect—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application of—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/i" id="article-4-1-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 5 of Schedule 10 to the Water Resources Act 1991 as originally enacted or as modified by the Control of Pollution (Discharges by the National Rivers Authority) Regulations 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/a/ii" id="article-4-1-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>regulations 2 to 6 of the Control of Pollution (Consents for Discharges <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>) (Secretary of State Functions) Regulations 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
<P3para>
<Text>in relation to any application made under paragraph 1 of that Schedule (applications for discharge consents) before 31st December 1996 or any consent given under paragraph 5 of that Schedule (discharge consents granted without applications) before that date;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application of section 91 of the Water Resources Act 1991 as originally enacted (appeals in respect of consents under Chapter <Acronym Expansion="2">II</Acronym> of Part III of that Act), and regulations 2 and 7 of the Control of Pollution (Consents for Discharges etc.) (Secretary of State Functions) Regulations 1989, in relation to any appeal under that section made in relation to a decision taken before 31st December 1996;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/1/c" id="article-4-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the power to amend or revoke any of the regulations mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) above.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (1)(a) above shall not apply in relation to an application made under paragraph 1 of Schedule 10 to the Water Resources Act 1991 before 31st December 1996 if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/2909/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application relates to discharges of a kind which the applicant, or a predecessor of his, was authorised to make by virtue of a consent to which paragraph 21 of Schedule 23 to the Environment Act 1995 (transitional provisions in relation to discharge consents) applied; and</Text>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-09-17"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 1 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000 c. 23">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act shall come into force on 25th September 2000:</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act shall come into force on 2nd October 2000:</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 1(3) of the Act shall come into force on 24th October 2000.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendment made to section 45 of the Telecommunications Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> by paragraph 3 of Schedule 4 to the Act shall come into force on 2nd October 2000 subject to the following provision.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In respect of the disclosure, before the coming into force of sections 21 to 25 of the Act, of matter falling within paragraph (b) of section 45(1) of the Telecommunications Act 1984, the amendment shall not affect the continuing effect of paragraphs (a) and (c) of section 45(2), and of section 45(3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 65(2)(b) of the Act, and the repeal by Schedule 5 of:</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/a" id="article-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 7 of and Schedule 1 to the Interception of Communications Act 1985<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/b" id="article-6-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 5 of and Schedules 1 and 2 to the Security Service Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/c" id="article-6-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 9 of and Schedules 1 and 2 to the Intelligence Services Act 1994, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/1/d" id="article-6-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 102 of and Schedule 7 to the Police Act 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>shall come into force on 2nd October 2000 subject to the following provisions.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any complaint made before 2nd October 2000 to the Tribunal established under section 7 of the Interception of Communications Act 1985 shall be dealt with by that Tribunal in accordance with that Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any complaint made before 2nd October 2000 to the Tribunal established under section 5 of the Security Service Act 1989 shall be dealt with by that Tribunal in accordance with that Act, but the functions of the Commissioner in respect of those complaints shall be discharged by the Intelligence Services Commissioner<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/4" id="article-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any complaint made before 2nd October 2000 to the Tribunal established under section 9 of the Intelligence Services Act 1994 shall be dealt with by that Tribunal in accordance with that Act, but the functions of the Commissioner in respect of those complaints shall be discharged by the Intelligence Services Commissioner.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2543/article/6/5" id="article-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any complaint made before 2nd October 2000 to a Surveillance Commissioner by virtue of section 102 of the Police Act 1997 shall be dealt with by that Commissioner in accordance with that Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-11-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Utilities Act 2000 c. 27">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Utilities Act 2000;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Electricity Act 1989 c .29">Electricity Act</Abbreviation>” means the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas Act 1986 c. 44">Gas Act</Abbreviation>” means the Gas Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 3 to 12, 7th November 2000 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas and Electricity Consumer Council">the Council</Abbreviation> pursuant to section 19(4)(a) objects to the disclosure of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from disclosing that information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 19(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from disclosing.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 19(4)(b).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>

The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000. 2 In this Order— “the Act” means the Utilities Act 2000; and b until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”. 5 In section 42AA of the Electricity Act (which section 20(6) inserts into that Act)— a until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 38(4) of Schedule 6, the duty of the Council to publish information relating to complaints shall relate to complaints made by consumers about any matter relating to the activities of public electricity suppliers (as defined in section 6(9) of the Electricity Act) and the holders of a licence granted under section 6(2)(a) of the Electricity Act and “complaints” in section 42AA(2) of the Electricity Act shall be construed accordingly; and b until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”. 6 1 Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by the Council pursuant to section 21(4)(a) objects to the publication of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from publishing that information. 2 On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 21(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from publishing. 3 For the purposes of paragaphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 21(4)(b). 10 1 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in sections 105(3)(a) and 105(8)(c) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply, the Director General of Electricity Supply” and in section 105(11) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply or the Director General of Electricity Supply”. 2 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 29(2) of Schedule 6, in section 105(3)(b) there is omitted “or section 28(2A) of the 1989 Act”. 3 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 6, in relation to section 48 of the Gas Act, in section 105(10) in the definition of “relevant activities” for “gas transporter” there is substituted “public gas transporter”. 11 Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in paragraph 31 of Schedule 7— a in sub-paragraphs (3) and (4) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply”; <Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-11-04"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Utilities Act 2000 c. 27">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Utilities Act 2000;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Electricity Act 1989 c .29">Electricity Act</Abbreviation>” means the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas Act 1986 c. 44">Gas Act</Abbreviation>” means the Gas Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 3 to 12, 7th November 2000 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas and Electricity Consumer Council">the Council</Abbreviation> pursuant to section 19(4)(a) objects to the disclosure of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from disclosing that information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 19(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from disclosing.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 19(4)(b).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in section 19(5) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply, the Director General of Electrical Supply”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 33DA of the Gas Act (which section 20(5) inserts into that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 6 for “gas transporters” or “transporters” in all places where the words occur there is substituted “public gas transporters”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 42AA of the Electricity Act (which section 20(6) inserts into that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 38(4) of Schedule 6, the duty of the Council to publish information relating to complaints shall relate to complaints made by consumers about any matter relating to the activities of public electricity suppliers (as defined in section 6(9) of the Electricity Act) and the holders of a licence granted under section 6(2)(a) of the Electricity Act and “complaints” in section 42AA(2) of the Electricity Act shall be construed accordingly; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where at any time before the appointed day any individual or body consulted by the Council pursuant to section 21(4)(a) objects to the publication of any information relating to it the Council shall until the appointed day refrain from publishing that information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>On and after the appointed day the entirety of section 21(4) shall apply to any information which, pursuant to paragraph (1), the Council has refrained from publishing.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of paragaphs (1) and (2), the “appointed day” means the day appointed for the coming into force of section 21(4)(b).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 32 of the Gas Act (which section 22(1) substitutes for the original section 32 of that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/a" id="article-7-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 95 for any purpose which includes the exercise by the Authority of its powers under section 30A(1) of the Gas Act (which section 95 inserts into that Act), there is omitted from the definition of “enforcement function” in subsection (10) “or 30A”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/7/b" id="article-7-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” in each place where it appears there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In section 46 of the Electricity Act (which section 22(2) substitutes for the original section 46 of that Act)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/a" id="article-8-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 59 for any purpose which includes the exercise by the Authority of its powers under section 27A(1) of the Electricity Act (which section 59 inserts into that Act), there is omitted from the definition of “enforcement function” in subsection (10) “or 27A”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/8/b" id="article-8-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1) for “Authority” in each place where it appears there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in section 33 of the Gas Act (which section 23(1) substitutes for the original section 33 of that Act) and in section 46A of the Electricity Act (which section 23(2) inserts into that Act) for “Authority” in all places where it occurs there is substituted “Director”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/1" id="article-10-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in sections 105(3)(a) and 105(8)(c) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply, the Director General of Electricity Supply” and in section 105(11) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply or the Director General of Electricity Supply”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/2" id="article-10-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 29(2) of Schedule 6, in section 105(3)(b) there is omitted “or section 28(2A) of the 1989 Act”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/10/3" id="article-10-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 6, in relation to section 48 of the Gas Act, in section 105(10) in the definition of “relevant activities” for “gas transporter” there is substituted “public gas transporter”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in paragraph 31 of Schedule 7—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/a" id="article-11-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraphs (3) and (4) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Gas Supply”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/11/b" id="article-11-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (5) there is omitted “the Authority and”, for “them” there is substituted “it” and for “their” there is substituted “its”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force of section 3(1), in paragraph 32 of Schedule 7—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/a" id="article-12-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraphs (3) and (4) for “Authority” there is substituted “Director General of Electricity Supply”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2974/article/12/b" id="article-12-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (5) there is omitted “the Authority and”, for “them” there is substituted “it” and for “their” there is substituted “its”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Child Support, Pensions and Social Security Act 2000 (Commencement No. 3) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-11-07"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Child Support, Pensions and Social Security Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3) Order 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order references to “the Act” are references to the Child Support, Pensions and Social Security Act 2000 and, except where otherwise stated, references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of, and Schedules to, the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act specified in Part I of the Schedule to this Order for the purpose of the exercise of powers to make regulations and Acts of Sederunt is 10th November 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act specified in Part II of the Schedule to this Order—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purpose of the exercise of the power to make regulations is 10th November 2000, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for all other purposes is 1st January 2001.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of paragraph 11(17) of Schedule 3 and section 26 so far as it relates to that paragraph is 1st January 2001.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4" id="article-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of sections 57 and 58 of the Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/a" id="article-2-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purpose of the exercise of the power to make regulations is 15th November 2000, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/b" id="article-2-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for all other purposes is 9th April 2001.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/5" id="article-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of sections 59 and 61 of the Act is 1st January 2001.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/6" id="article-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of section 60 of the Act and Part IV of Schedule 9 to the Act is 9th April 2001.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4" id="article-2-4">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/4/b" id="article-2-4-b">

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/5" id="article-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/2994/article/2/6" id="article-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
