UK_uksi_2000_3343/8419ea61a2.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000</dc:title><Made Date="2000-12-19"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Utilities Act 2000 c. 27">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Utilities Act 2000;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Electricity Act 1989 c .29">Electricity Act</Abbreviation>” means the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Gas Act 1986 c. 44">Gas Act</Abbreviation>” means the Gas Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Until the appointed day for the coming into force for all remaining purposes of section 51(2) and Schedule 4, Schedule 6 to the Electricity Act (as that Schedule had effect on the passing of the Act) shall continue to have effect as if section 51(2) had not come into force.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1" id="article-10-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing exercise by the Authority of either the functions assigned to it by section 36A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> of the Gas Act or functions which it exercises concurrently with the Director General of Fair Trading by virtue of section 43(3)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> of the Electricity Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/a" id="article-10-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Authority shall exercise its functions as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/1/b" id="article-10-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 4B(3) of the Gas Act (which section 12 inserts into that Act) and section 3D(4) of the Electricity Act (which section 16 inserts into that Act) shall have no effect.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/10/2" id="article-10-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article “continuing exercise” means any exercise of the functions described in paragraph (1) which has been commenced but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/1" id="article-11-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing modification reference made to the Competition Commission under section 24<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> of the Gas Act or section 12<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> of the Electricity Act the Competition Commission shall exercise its functions under sections 24 and 25<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/> of the Gas Act or sections 12 and 13<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> of the Electricity Act in respect of the investigation of and report on that reference and the Authority shall exercise its functions in respect of the receipt of any report on that reference (under section 25 of the Gas Act or section 13 of the Electricity Act) and any modification of the conditions of any licence following such a report (where such modification is made pursuant to section 26<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> of the Gas Act or section 14<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> of the Electricity Act) as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A of the Gas Act and section 3 of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/11/2" id="article-11-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article a “continuing modification reference” means one which has been made to the Competition Commission before 20th December 2000 but on which either the Commission has not reported before 20th December 2000 or, the Commisson having reported, the Director General of Gas Supply or Director General of Electricity Supply has not before 20th December 2000 concluded the exercise of his functions under section 26 of the Gas Act (in the case of the Director General of Gas Supply) or section 14 of the Electricity Act (in the case of the Director General of Electricity Supply).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/1" id="article-12-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing application which is either a request for the revocation of a licence or has been made under sections 7B(1)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/> or 8AA<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/> of the Gas Act or section 6(3) of the Electricity Act, the Secretary of State and the Authority shall exercise their functions in respect of such an application as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/12/2" id="article-12-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article, a “continuing application” means one which has been made but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/13" id="article-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/1" id="article-13-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing proposal which has been made under either sections 23<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/> or 29(1)(a) of the Gas Act or sections 11 or 26(1)(a) of the Electricity Act, the Authority shall exercise its functions in respect of such a proposal as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/13/2" id="article-13-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article a “continuing proposal” means one which has been made but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/14" id="article-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/1" id="article-14-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any continuing dispute which has been referred under section 27A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00018"/> of the Gas Act to the Director General of Gas Supply, the Authority (which for the purposes of this article includes any arbitrator or arbiter appointed pursuant to section 27A(1)(b) of the Gas Act) shall exercise its functions in respect of such a dispute as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A of the Gas Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/14/2" id="article-14-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article “continuing dispute” means one which has been referred to the Director General of Gas Supply but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/15" id="article-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/1" id="article-15-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of any outstanding request which has been made (in the case of the Gas Act) in accordance with a licence condition imposed under section 7B of that Act either to the Director General of Gas Supply or the Secretary of State for a determination of such questions arising under the licence, or under any document specified or described in the licence, as are specified in the licence or are of a description so specified or for designation, acceptance or approval by the said Director General or Secretary of State or (in the case of the Electricity Act) in accordance with a licence condition imposed under section 7 of that Act to the Director General of Electricity Supply for a determination of such questions arising under the licence as are specified in the licence or are of a description so specified or for approval by the said Director General of such things falling to be done under the licence, and such contracts or agreements made before the grant of the licence as are specified in the licence or are of a description so specified, the Authority or, as the case may be, the Secretary of State shall exercise its functions in the case of such a request as if, notwithstanding any provisions of the Act, sections 4 and 4A in the case of the Gas Act and section 3 in the case of the Electricity Act had not been replaced.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/3343/article/15/2" id="article-15-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of this article “outstanding request” means one which has been made to the Secretary of State, the Director General of Gas Supply, or the Director General of Electricity Supply but not determined before 20th December 2000.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>

The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2001 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2001. 2 In this Order— “the Act” means the Utilities Act 2000; “the Electricity Act” means the Electricity Act 1989; and “the Gas Act” means the Gas Act 1986. 3 In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act. 2 Subject to articles 3 to 10, 16th May 2001 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column. 3 The commencement of section 30 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 6 of the Electricity Act. 4 The commencement of section 46(3) for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 19(2) of the Electricity Act. 5 The commencement of section 58 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 42A of the Electricity Act. 6 The commencement of section 62 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 32 of the Electricity Act. 7 The commencement of section 82(4) for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 23(12) of the Gas Act. 8 The commencement of section 94 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 33D of the Gas Act. 9 The commencement of paragraph 13(a) of Schedule 6 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order, does not have the effect of substituting section 33A(1) and (2) of the Gas Act. 10 The commencement of paragraph 32(a) of Schedule 6 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 39(1) of the Electricity Act. SCHEDULE PROVISIONS OF THE UTILITIES ACT 2000 COMING INTO FORCE ON 16TH MAY 2001 Article 2
Provisions of the ActPurpose
Section 30 (licences authorising supply etc. of electricity and procedures for licence applications) For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make regulations prescribing— the form and manner in which an application for a generation licence, transmission licence, distribution licence or supply licence, as defined in paragraph (a), (b), (c) or (d) of section 6(1) of the Electricity Act or an application for the extension or restriction of a distribution or supply licence is to be made; the information, documents and any fee which should accompany any application; and the period within which, after the making of the application, the applicant shall publish a notice of the application and the manner of that publication
Section 32 (electricity licence conditions)For the purpose of the determination by the Secretary of State of standard licence conditions pursuant to section 33(1)
Section 33(1) and (2) (standard conditions of electricity licences)For all purposes
Section 35 (modification of standard conditions of licences)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to make an order prescribing the percentages referred to in paragraph (b) of section 11A(6) of the Electricity Act and the weighting referred to in section 11A(7) of that Act
Section 46(1) and (3) to (5) (power to recover expenditure)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to consult with the Authority and to make regulations relating to the recovery and application of reasonably incurred expenditure by an electricity distributor as provided for in section 19(2) and (3) of the Electricity Act
Section 52 (amendment to Schedule 7 to the Electricity Act)For the purpose of giving effect to paragraphs 1, 3(1) and (2) and 4 of Schedule 5 to enable the Authority to make and the Secretary of State to consent to the making of regulations under paragraph 1(1A) of Schedule 7 to the Electricity Act
Section 54(2) (standards of performance in individual cases: electricity distributors)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make and the Secretary of State to consent to the making of regulations prescribing standards of performance in connection with the activities of electricity distributors as provided for in section 39A of the Electricity Act and the person (where this is not the Authority) by whom a reference shall be determined and the practice and procedure to be followed in connection with any determination of any dispute arising under section 39 or 39A of the Electricity Act or regulations made under either of those sections, as provided for in section 39B of the Electricity Act
Section 55 (overall standards of performance: electricity distributors)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to determine and arrange for the publication of overall standards of performance in connection with the activities of electricity distributors as provided for in section 40A(1) and (2) of the Electricity Act
Section 56 (procedures for prescribing or determining standards of performance)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to comply with the procedures for prescribing or determining standards of performance required by section 40B of the Electricity Act
Section 58 (information to be given to customers about overall performance)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make regulations as provided for in section 42A of the Electricity Act
Section 62 (obligation in connection with electricity from renewable sources)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to undertake the consultation required by section 32(7) of the Electricity Act before an order may be made by him under section 32(1) of that Act
Section 74(1) and (7) (gas licence conditions and procedures for licence applications) For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make regulations prescribing— the form and manner in which an application for the grant, extension or restriction of a licence under section 7 or 7A of the Gas Act is to be made; the information, documents and fee which accompany any application; and the period within which, after the making of the application, the applicant should publish a notice of the application and the manner of that publication
Section 74(3) to (6) (gas licence conditions)For the purpose of the determination by the Secretary of State of standard licence conditions pursuant to section 81(2)
Section 81(1) and (2) (standard conditions of gas licences)For all purposes
Section 82(4) (modification of standard conditions of gas licences)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to make an order prescribing the percentages referred to in paragraph (b) of section 23(7) of the Gas Act and the weighting referred to in section 23(8) of that Act
Section 90(2) (standards of performance in individual cases: gas transporters)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make and the Secretary of State to consent to the making of regulations prescribing standards of performance in connection with the activities of gas transporters as provided for in section 33AA of the Gas Act and the person (where this is not the Authority) by whom a reference shall be determined and the practice and procedure to be followed in connection with any determination of any dispute arising under section 33A or 33AA or regulations made under either of those sections, as provided for in section 33AB of the Gas Act
Section 91 (overall standards of performance: gas transporters)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to determine and arrange for the publication of overall standards of performance in connection with the activities of gas transporters as provided for in section 33BA of the Gas Act
Section 92 (procedures for prescribing or determining standards of performance)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to comply with the procedures for prescribing or determining standards of performance required by section 33BAA of the Gas Act
Section 94 (information to be given to customers about overall performance)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make regulations as provided for in section 33D of the Gas Act
Section 104 (specialist members of the Competition Commission)For all purposes

The Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2001 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Utilities Act 2000 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2001. 2 In this Order— “the Act” means the Utilities Act 2000; “the Electricity Act” means the Electricity Act 1989; and “the Gas Act” means the Gas Act 1986. 3 In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act. 2 Subject to articles 3 to 10, 16th May 2001 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column. 3 The commencement of section 30 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 6 of the Electricity Act. 4 The commencement of section 46(3) for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 19(2) of the Electricity Act. 5 The commencement of section 58 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 42A of the Electricity Act. 6 The commencement of section 62 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 32 of the Electricity Act. 7 The commencement of section 82(4) for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 23(12) of the Gas Act. 8 The commencement of section 94 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 33D of the Gas Act. 9 The commencement of paragraph 13(a) of Schedule 6 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order, does not have the effect of substituting section 33A(1) and (2) of the Gas Act. 10 The commencement of paragraph 32(a) of Schedule 6 for the purpose set out in the second column of the Schedule to this Order does not have the effect of substituting section 39(1) of the Electricity Act. SCHEDULE PROVISIONS OF THE UTILITIES ACT 2000 COMING INTO FORCE ON 16TH MAY 2001 Article 2
Provisions of the ActPurpose
Section 30 (licences authorising supply etc. of electricity and procedures for licence applications) For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make regulations prescribing— the form and manner in which an application for a generation licence, transmission licence, distribution licence or supply licence, as defined in paragraph (a), (b), (c) or (d) of section 6(1) of the Electricity Act or an application for the extension or restriction of a distribution or supply licence is to be made; the information, documents and any fee which should accompany any application; and the period within which, after the making of the application, the applicant shall publish a notice of the application and the manner of that publication
Section 32 (electricity licence conditions)For the purpose of the determination by the Secretary of State of standard licence conditions pursuant to section 33(1)
Section 33(1) and (2) (standard conditions of electricity licences)For all purposes
Section 35 (modification of standard conditions of licences)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to make an order prescribing the percentages referred to in paragraph (b) of section 11A(6) of the Electricity Act and the weighting referred to in section 11A(7) of that Act
Section 46(1) and (3) to (5) (power to recover expenditure)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to consult with the Authority and to make regulations relating to the recovery and application of reasonably incurred expenditure by an electricity distributor as provided for in section 19(2) and (3) of the Electricity Act
Section 52 (amendment to Schedule 7 to the Electricity Act)For the purpose of giving effect to paragraphs 1, 3(1) and (2) and 4 of Schedule 5 to enable the Authority to make and the Secretary of State to consent to the making of regulations under paragraph 1(1A) of Schedule 7 to the Electricity Act
Section 54(2) (standards of performance in individual cases: electricity distributors)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make and the Secretary of State to consent to the making of regulations prescribing standards of performance in connection with the activities of electricity distributors as provided for in section 39A of the Electricity Act and the person (where this is not the Authority) by whom a reference shall be determined and the practice and procedure to be followed in connection with any determination of any dispute arising under section 39 or 39A of the Electricity Act or regulations made under either of those sections, as provided for in section 39B of the Electricity Act
Section 55 (overall standards of performance: electricity distributors)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to determine and arrange for the publication of overall standards of performance in connection with the activities of electricity distributors as provided for in section 40A(1) and (2) of the Electricity Act

Section 58 (information to be given to customers about overall performance)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make regulations as provided for in section 42A of the Electricity Act
Section 62 (obligation in connection with electricity from renewable sources)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to undertake the consultation required by section 32(7) of the Electricity Act before an order may be made by him under section 32(1) of that Act
Section 74(1) and (7) (gas licence conditions and procedures for licence applications) For the purpose of enabling the Authority to make regulations prescribing— the form and manner in which an application for the grant, extension or restriction of a licence under section 7 or 7A of the Gas Act is to be made; the information, documents and fee which accompany any application; and the period within which, after the making of the application, the applicant should publish a notice of the application and the manner of that publication
Section 74(3) to (6) (gas licence conditions)For the purpose of the determination by the Secretary of State of standard licence conditions pursuant to section 81(2)
Section 81(1) and (2) (standard conditions of gas licences)For all purposes
Section 82(4) (modification of standard conditions of gas licences)For the purpose of enabling the Secretary of State to make an order prescribing the percentages referred to in paragraph (b) of section 23(7) of the Gas Act and the weighting referred to in section 23(8) of that Act

Section 91 (overall standards of performance: gas transporters)For the purpose of enabling the Authority to determine and arrange for the publication of overall standards of performance in connection with the activities of gas transporters as provided for in section 33BA of the Gas Act

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Enterprise Act 2002 (Commencement No.3, Transitional and Transitory Provisions and Savings) Order 2003.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “<Abbreviation Expansion="Enterprise Act 2002 c. 40">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Enterprise Act 2002.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>20th June 2003 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>20th June 2003 is “the appointed day” for the purposes of paragraphs 13 to 18 of Schedule 24 to the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the Schedule to this Order states that any amendment, repeal or revocation comes into force for all purposes subject to this paragraph, it does not come into force for purposes relating to—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the making by the Secretary of State of references under section 32 of the Water Industry Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> (duty to refer merger of water or sewerage undertakings), or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references so made.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The modifications in paragraphs (3) to (5) apply until the coming into force of section 70 and Schedule 6 (which are to replace sections 32 to 35 of the Water Industry Act 1991).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 35(4) of the Water Industry Act 1991 shall have effect as if for the words from “the Secretary of State” to “the 1973 Act” there were substituted “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Office of Fair Trading">OFT</Abbreviation> or the Secretary of State, in a case in which, or to any extent to which, the Secretary of State is not required to make a reference under section 32 above, to make a reference under Part 3 of the 2002 Act”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/4" id="article-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph 5 of Schedule 1 to the Competition Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> shall have effect as if in paragraph (d) for “OFT” there were substituted “Secretary of State”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5" id="article-3-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 121 shall have effect as if the following were omitted—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5/a" id="article-3-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (1) the words from “and sections 32” to the end;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5/b" id="article-3-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection (3)(d); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/5/c" id="article-3-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (8) the words from “and sections 32” to the end.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/3/6" id="article-3-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph 13 of Schedule 24 shall not apply in any case in which the Secretary of State is required to make a reference under section 32 of the Water Industry Act 1991.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraphs 15 to 18 of Schedule 24, the old law shall in particular continue to apply in relation to the enforcement, variation or release of any undertakings accepted before the appointed day under section 75G or 88 of the 1973 Act in relation to any relevant arrangements which are not otherwise dealt with by paragraph 13 of Schedule 24.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The power of the decision-making authority under section 27(5) or 29(1) (including those provisions as applied by any enactment) in relation to events or transactions is exercisable in relation to a merger which has occurred before the appointed day where the merger forms part of successive events or a series of transactions which include at least one event or transaction to which the new law applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the decision-making authority exercises its power as mentioned in paragraph (2) in relation to a merger which has occurred before the appointed day, paragraph 13(1) of Schedule 24 shall accordingly cease to apply in relation to the merger.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/4/4" id="article-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“appointed day”, “relevant arrangements”, “new law” and “old law” have the same meaning as in paragraph 13 of Schedule 24;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“enactment” has the meaning given by section 129(1); and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“merger” means a ceasing of two or more enterprises to be distinct enterprises (within the meaning of Part 5 of the 1973 Act).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The commencement of section 17 shall not have effect in relation to any decision made before the 20th June 2003 and any application to the OFT or appeal to the Competition Appeal Tribunal in relation to such a decision may be made or proceeded with notwithstanding the commencement of section 17.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The commencement of the amendments, repeals and revocations in Schedules 25 and 26 relating to the 1973 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> shall not have effect in relation to—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/6/a" id="article-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any orders which by virtue of paragraph 1 of Schedule 11 to that Act have effect as if made under that Act, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/6/b" id="article-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>undertakings to which paragraph 9 of Schedule 11 to that Act applies.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where any proceedings have been commenced under Part III of the 1973 Act before the 20th June 2003 then those proceedings shall not be affected by the repeal of Part III but may be continued until they are finally determined (including any appeals that may be brought) and the Court may make any order that it could have made on the application had Part III not been repealed.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The commencement of the provisions of Schedules 11, 25 and 26 shall not have effect in relation to any reference that is made (or, in the case of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, any investigation that is commenced) before the 20th June 2003 under any of the following provisions—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/a" id="article-8-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 11 of the Competition Act 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/b" id="article-8-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 13 of the Telecommunications Act 1984<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/c" id="article-8-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 43 of the Airports Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/d" id="article-8-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 24 or 41E of the Gas Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/e" id="article-8-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 12 or 56C of the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/f" id="article-8-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 4 to the Broadcasting Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/g" id="article-8-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 12 or 14 of the Water Industry Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/h" id="article-8-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Article 15 of the Electricity (Northern Ireland) Order 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/i" id="article-8-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 13 of, or Schedule 4A to, the Railways Act 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/j" id="article-8-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Article 34 of the Airports (Northern Ireland) Order 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/k" id="article-8-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Article 15 of the Gas (Northern Ireland) Order 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/l/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/l" id="article-8-l">
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 15 of the Postal Services Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/m" id="article-8-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 162 or 306 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/8/n" id="article-8-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 12 of the Transport Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00018"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The commencement of the repeal of section 125 of the 1973 Act and section 5 of the Consumer Credit Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00019"/> shall not have effect in relation to the making, laying and publishing of the annual report referred to in paragraph 5 of Schedule 24.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The commencement by this Order of the repeal of an enactment previously repealed subject to savings does not affect the continued operation of those savings.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The commencement of the repeal of section 6 of the 1973 Act shall not have effect in relation to the references to that section in the Telecommunications (Licence Modification) (Mobile Public Telecommunication Operators) Regulations 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00020"/>, the Telecommunications (Licence Modification) (British Telecommunications plc) Regulations 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00021"/> or the Telecommunications (Licence Modification) (Kingston Communications (Hull) plc) Regulations 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00022"/>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/1397/article/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/1397/article/12" id="article-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The commencement of the provisions of Schedules 25 and 26 in relation to the Registered Designs Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00023"/>, the Agricultural Marketing Act 1958<FootnoteRef Ref="f00024"/>, the Patents Act 1977<FootnoteRef Ref="f00025"/> and the Agricultural Marketing (Northern Ireland) Order 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00026"/> shall not have effect to prevent the taking of any action, or to affect the enforcement of any requirement or licence terms resulting from any action taken, pursuant to these enactments following a report of the Commission made before the 20th June 2003.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Section 367 of the principal Act shall come into force on 9th March 2004 for the purposes of enabling regulations to be made under section 6(1) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 1967 as amended by that section.

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Office of Communications Act 2002 (Commencement No. 3) and Communications Act 2003 (Commencement No. 2) Order 2003</dc:title><Made Date="2003-12-08"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/3142/article/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/3142/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-c70674"/>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/3142/article/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/3142/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Office of Communications Act 2002 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 3) and Communications Act 2003 (Commencement No. 2) Order 2003.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/3142/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/3142/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Wireless Telegraphy Act 1949 c. 54">1949 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Wireless Telegraphy Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Broadcasting Act 1990 c. 42">1990 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Broadcasting Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Broadcasting Act 1996 c. 55">1996 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Broadcasting Act 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Broadcasting Standards Commission">BSC</Abbreviation>” means the Broadcasting Standards Commission;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the first commencement order” means the Communications Act 2003 (Commencement No. 1) Order 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Independent Television Commission">ITC</Abbreviation>” means the Independent Television Commission;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Communications Act 2003 c. 21">principal Act</Abbreviation>” means the Communications Act 2003;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“television licence” and “television receiver” have the meanings provided by section 1(7) of the 1949 Act; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the transitionally commenced provisions” has the same meaning as in the first commencement order.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/1" id="article-10-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The repeal of sections 45(5) to (6A) and 47(8) to (9A) of the 1990 Act shall not affect the operation of section 41 of that Act, as applied by those provisions, in relation to any matter arising before the coming into force of those repeals.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/2" id="article-10-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the period beginning with the transfer of functions from the ITC to OFCOM on 29th December 2003 in accordance with the provisions of the principal Act brought into force by this Order and ending immediately before section 299(1) of the principal Act is brought into force by this Order on 30th June 2004, for the reference to “the Commission” in section 97(2)(c) of the 1996 Act there shall be substituted a reference to “OFCOM”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/3" id="article-10-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to any time between the commencement of the repeal of section 2 of the 1990 Act on 29th December 2003 and the commencement of the repeal of section 181 of that Act on 1st April 2004, section 181 shall have effect as if the definition of “television broadcasting service” in subsection (4) were—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“television broadcasting service” means a television broadcasting service within the meaning of Part 3 of the Communications Act 2003, whether provided by the holder of a licence under Part 1 of this Act or by the <Acronym Expansion="British Broadcasting Corporation">BBC</Acronym> or the Welsh Authority.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/3142/article/10/4" id="article-10-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to any time between the commencement of the repeal of section 2 of the 1990 Act on 29th December 2003 and the coming into force of any revocation of regulation 3 of the Wireless Telegraphy (Television Licence Fees) Regulations 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>, the reference in that regulation to “television programme services” as defined by section 2(4) of the 1990 Act shall be read as if it were a reference to such services as defined by section 362 of the principal Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

The Enterprise Act 2002 (Commencement No. 2, Transitional and Transitory Provisions) Order 2003 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Enterprise Act 2002 (Commencement No. 2, Transitional and Transitory Provisions) Order 2003. 2 In this Order— “the Act” means the Enterprise Act 2002; “appeal tribunal” means an appeal tribunal of the Competition Commission; “existing appeal” means an appeal made to the Competition Commission under section 46 or 47 of the Competition Act 1998 or regulation 25 or 26 of the EC Competition Law (Articles 84 and 85) Enforcement Regulations 2001 which has not been finally determined before 1st April 2003; and “the Tribunal” means the Competition Appeal Tribunal. 3 In this Order (save where the context otherwise requires) references to sections and Schedules are references to sections of and Schedules to the Act. 2 1st April 2003 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column. 3 1 Any existing appeal shall be deemed to have been made to the Tribunal and shall continue as an appeal to the Tribunal and anything having any continuing effect done in relation to an existing appeal (including anything done for the purpose of an appeal from a decision made in relation to an existing appeal and anything done in connection with a request for a preliminary ruling of the Court of Justice of the European Communities in relation to an existing appeal) shall be deemed for all purposes to have been done in relation to an appeal to the Tribunal and is not to be invalidated by the commencement of any of the provisions brought into force by this Order. 2 Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), for the purposes of any existing appeal, anything done by the President of the Competition Commission Appeal Tribunals, the Registrar of Appeal Tribunals, and an appeal tribunal shall be deemed for all purposes to have been done by the President of the Competition Appeal Tribunal, the Registrar of the Competition Appeal Tribunal, and the Tribunal, respectively, and the members of any tribunal constituted by the President of the Competition Commission Appeal Tribunals in relation to an existing appeal in accordance with paragraph 27 of Schedule 7 to the Competition Act 1998 shall be treated as being the members of the Tribunal constituted in accordance with section 14 of the Act for the purposes of the relevant appeal. <P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/e" id="article-2-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 18 (wardens);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/f" id="article-2-1-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 20 (codes of conduct and other information);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/g" id="article-2-1-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 46(3) (which introduces Schedule 4) in so far as it relates to the provisions in Schedule 4 referred to in sub-paragraph (i) below;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/h" id="article-2-1-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 2 (restrictions to be observed by persons exercising right of access); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/1/i" id="article-2-1-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 2 (amendment to the Forestry Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>) and 3 (amendment to the Agriculture Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>) of Schedule 4.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of section 2 in so far as it relates to any access land—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/i" id="article-2-2-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which is access land solely by virtue of section 1(1)(e); and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2173/article/2/2/ii" id="article-2-2-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which lies within an area covered by one of the maps in conclusive form referred to in paragraph (1)(a)(ii) above,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>is 19th September 2004 or the end of a period of six months beginning with the day on which the land is dedicated for the purposes of Part I under section 16 (dedication of land as access land), whichever is the later.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P1para>

</P2>
</P1para>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to article 4, the following provisions of the Act shall come into force on 28th September 2004, in relation to England–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 2, so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 38</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/d" id="article-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 39;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/e" id="article-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 113;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/f" id="article-2-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 114 so far as it relates to Part 2 of the Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/g" id="article-2-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 119(1), so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/h" id="article-2-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 6, paragraphs 1, so far as it is not yet in force, paragraphs 8 to 13, 15, 16(1) and (2), 17 and 18, paragraph 19, so far as it is not yet in force, and paragraphs 21, 22 and 25;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/i" id="article-2-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 7, paragraphs 2, 3, 6, 8, 11(1) to (3), 16 and 17, paragraph 19(2), so far as it is not yet in force and paragraphs 22 and 23;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/j" id="article-2-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 8, so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/2/k" id="article-2-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 9, so far as it gives effect to the repeals specified in Part 1 of Schedule 1 to this Order.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to article 4, the following provisions of the Act shall come into force on 28th September 2004 in relation to England and Wales–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Part 5, so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 117(1) to (7), so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 118, except so much of subsection (2) as relates to the Town and Country Planning (Scotland) Act 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, and so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Section 120, except so far as it relates to the Town and Country Planning (Scotland) Act 1997, to the Planning (Listed Building and Conservation Areas)(Scotland) Act 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> and to the Planning (Hazardous Substances)(Scotland) Act 1997<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, and so far as it is not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/e" id="article-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 6, paragraphs 20, 23, 24 and 26, so far as they are not yet in force;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/3/f" id="article-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 9, so far as it gives effect to the repeals specified in Part 2 of Schedule 1 to this Order.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions set out in Schedule 2 shall continue to have effect on and after 28th September 2004</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">

<P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2202/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2202/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">

</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>as if those provisions had not been amended or repealed by the Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004 (Commencement) (England and Scotland) Order 2004</dc:title><Made Date="2004-09-06"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004 (Commencement) (England and Scotland) Order 2004.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order does not apply in relation to Wales.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fire Services Act 1947 c. 41">1947 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fire Services Act 1947<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004 c. 21">2004 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>So far as it enables an order to be made under section 19 (charging), section 21 (Fire and Rescue National Framework) and section 36 (preservation of existing pension scheme), the 2004 Act shall come into force on 7th September 2004.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to article 3 the 2004 Act shall, insofar as it is not already in force, come into force on 1st October 2004.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where, before 1st October 2004, a fire authority provides a service to another person or contracts to provide such a service in exercise of its powers under sections 3(1)(e) or 3(4A) of the 1947 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, any charges which relate to the provision of that service shall be treated as payable under the 1947 Act, notwithstanding the repeal of the 1947 Act by the 2004 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (3) applies where—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before 1st October 2004, an order is made under section 95 of the Local Government Act 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> authorising specified fire and rescue authorities to provide for a commercial purpose any specified service; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a specified fire and rescue authority provides, or contracts to provide, a specified service on or before 31st March 2005.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/2304/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this paragraph applies, any charge which relates to the provision of a specified service shall be treated as payable under the 1947 Act, notwithstanding the repeal of the 1947 Act by the 2004 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3para>

<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 9, the repeals relating to—</Text>

<P2para>

The Enterprise Act 2002 (Commencement No. 7 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 2004 1 1 This Order may be cited as the Enterprise Act 2002 (Commencement No. 7 and Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 2004. 2 In this Order— a “the 2002 Act” means the Enterprise Act 2002; b “the 1991 Act” means the Water Industry Act 1991; and c “water purposes” means purposes relating to— i the making by the Secretary of State of references under section 32 of the 1991 Act, or ii any references so made. 2 29th December 2004 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the provisions of the 2002 Act listed in the first column of the Schedule to this Order for the purposes set out in the second column. 3 1 Subject to paragraphs 15 to 18 of Schedule 24 to the 2002 Act, the old law shall continue to apply where a merger of two or more water enterprises has taken place before 29th December 2004. 2 The power of the decision-making authority under section 27(5) or 29(1) (including those provisions as applied by any enactment) in relation to events or transactions is exercisable, in relation to a merger of two or more water enterprises which has taken place before 29th December 2004, where the merger forms part of successive events or a series of transactions which include at least one event or transaction to which the new law applies. 3 Where the decision-making authority exercises its power as mentioned in paragraph (2) in relation to a merger of two or more water enterprises which has taken place before 29th December 2004, paragraph (1) shall accordingly cease to apply in relation to the merger. 4 In this article “enactment” includes an enactment comprised in secondary legislation, and includes an enactment whenever passed or made. 4 1 Subject to paragraphs 15 to 18 of Schedule 24 to the 2002 Act, the old law shall continue to apply in relation to any relevant arrangements which were in progress before 29th December 2004 and are in progress on that day and (if events so require) the actual results of those arrangements where, before 29th December 2004 and in relation to the arrangements, a reference was made by the Secretary of State under section 32(a) of the 1991 Act. 2 Subject to paragraphs 15 to 18 of Schedule 24 of the 2002 Act, the old law shall continue to apply in relation the enforcement, variation or release of any undertakings given before 29th December 2004 under section 88 of the 1973 Act in relation to any relevant arrangements which are not otherwise dealt with by paragraph (1). 3 The new law shall apply in relation to relevant arrangements and (if events so require) the results of those arrangements if— a the arrangements were in progress before 29th December 2004 and are in progress on that day, and b before that day and in relation to the arrangements, no reference was made by the Secretary of State under section 32(a) of the 1991 Act. 4 In this article— a “relevant arrangements” means arrangements which might result in the merger of two or more water enterprises; and b references to relevant arrangements which are in progress on 29th December 2004 include references to the actual results of those arrangements if the arrangements were in progress immediately before that day and have, at the beginning of that day, resulted in the merger of two or more water enterprises. 5 1 In articles 3 and 4— a “the new law” means– i sections 32 to 35 of, and Schedule 4ZA to, the 1991 Act (as substituted and inserted by section 70 of, and Schedule 6 to, the 2002 Act), ii such provisions of Part 3 of the 2002 Act as apply by virtue of (and with the modifications prescribed under) Schedule 4ZA to the 1991 Act, and iii any related provision of law, (including, in particular, any modification made under section 276(2) of the 2002 Act to any provision mentioned in paragraphs (i) to (iii)); b “the old law” means– i sections 32 to 35 of the 1991 Act (as in force immediately before 29th December 2004), ii such provisions of sections 64 to 75K of the 1973 Act as apply by virtue of section 34 of the 1991 Act immediately before that date, and iii any related provision of law, (including, in particular, any modification made under section 276(2) of the 2002 Act to any provision mentioned in paragraphs (i) to (iii)); and c references to the merger of two or more water enterprises shall be construed in accordance with section 35(1) and (2) of the 1991 Act, as in force immediately before 29th December 2004. 2 In articles 3 and 4, references to the old law, in relation to the period on or after 20th June 2003, include references to the old law with the following modifications— a section 35(4) of the 1991 Act has effect as if for the words from “the Secretary of State” to “the 1973 Act” there were substituted “the OFT or the Secretary of State, in a case in which, or to any extent to which, the Secretary of State is not required to make a reference under section 32 above, to make a reference under Part 3 of the 2002 Act”, b paragraph 5 of Schedule 1 to the 1998 Act has effect as if in paragraph (d) for “OFT” there were substituted “Secretary of State”, and c section 121 of the 2002 Act has effect as if the following were omitted– i in subsection (1), the words from “and sections 32” to the end, ii subsection (3)(d), and iii in subsection (8), the words from “and sections 32” to the end. 3 Paragraph 13 of Schedule 24 to the 2002 Act shall not apply in connection with the coming into force of any provision of the 2002 Act by virtue of this Order. <Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 Commencement (No.3) Order 2004</dc:title><Made Date="2004-03-09"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2004/759/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2004/759/article/1" id="article-1">
