<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Energy Act 2004 (Commencement No. 6) Order 2005</dc:title><Made Date="2005-10-17"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Energy Act 2004 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6) Order 2005.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Energy Act 2004 c. 20">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Energy Act 2004;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“adjustment formula” means a formula under which the price of electricity is adjusted having regard to the current market price of some other commodity;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“affiliate”, in relation to a body corporate that is the owner or operator of a generating station, means a subsidiary or holding company of that body corporate and any subsidiary or holding company of such holding company (and, for the purposes of this definition, “subsidiary” and “holding company” have the meanings ascribed to them in section 736 of the Companies Act 1985<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“applicable turnover” means the amounts, ascertained in conformity with normal accounting practice in Great Britain, which are—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>derived by a high electricity user from the provision of goods and services within that person’s ordinary activities; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>computed on an accruals basis so that the amounts referred to in paragraph (a) relating to the period for which applicable turnover is being determined are taken into account, without regard to the date of invoice or receipt of payment,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList><Text>after deduction of value added tax and any other taxes based on such amounts;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“connected person”, in relation to an owner or operator of a generating station, means a person connected to him within the meaning of section 839 of the Income and Corporation Taxes Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“distribution system” and “transmission system” have the meaning that those terms bear in the Electricity Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“high electricity user” means a body corporate which, for each year since the commencement of a long term, fixed-price contract under which electricity is supplied to it, has spent in excess of twenty per cent of its applicable turnover on electricity, and which receives under that contract at least ninety per cent of all the electricity which it receives;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“long term, fixed-price contract” means a contract entered into before 1st April 2002 which is still in force on the date this Order is made, and which provides for an electricity generator (or a person who is a connected person or an affiliate in relation to an electricity generator) to provide a specified amount (or a specified maximum amount) of electricity to a specified consumer at a price which is specified either numerically or by reference to an adjustment formula; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“stand-by electricity” means electricity conveyed temporarily, periodically or intermittently to make good any unplanned shortfall in the availability of electricity to the recipient for its own consumption from a generating station owned or operated by the recipient or by a person who is a connected person or an affiliate in relation to the recipient, where such shortfall arises from that generating station being wholly or partly out of commission for a temporary period.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 177 of the Act shall come into force on 1st November 2005.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Except for the purposes mentioned in paragraph (2), section 179 of the Act shall come into force on 1st April 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 179 shall come into force on 1st April 2010—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of sections 32 to 32C of the Electricity Act 1989, in respect of any electricity which (without being conveyed to the premises wholly or partly by means of a distribution system) is supplied to premises occupied by a high electricity user from a substation to which it has been conveyed by means of a transmission system; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in respect of any electricity which, being stand-by electricity, is supplied (without being conveyed to the premises wholly or partly by means of a distribution system) to premises occupied by a body corporate from a substation to which it has been conveyed by means of a transmission system.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 197(9) and Part 1 of Schedule 23, in so far as they relate to the repeal of section 28(3)(b) of the Utilities Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, shall come into force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on 1st April 2006 except for the purposes mentioned in article 3(2); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2965/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on 1st April 2010 for those purposes.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3para>

<P3para>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/i" id="article-2-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/ii" id="article-2-g-ii">

<P4para>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/2/g/iv" id="article-2-g-iv">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">

<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In particular, where, before the appointed day, a surveying authority has made a relevant order under section 54 of the 1981 Act, but that order has not yet come into operation—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1172/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">

</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>as if section 54 had not been repealed.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>1st October 2006 is the day appointed for the coming into force of section 33 of the Act.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this article, a reference to a section or Schedule by number alone means the section or Schedule so numbered in the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of sections 58 to 62 and 70, and Schedules 5 and 6—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/2/a" id="article-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/2/b" id="article-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for all other purposes, is 1st October 2006.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of section 71—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/3/a" id="article-4-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purpose of defining any expression relevant to the exercise of the power to make a direction, is 28th September 2006;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/3/b" id="article-4-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for all other purposes, and so far as it is not already in force<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, is 1st October 2006.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/4" id="article-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>1st October 2006 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions so far as they are not already in force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/4/a" id="article-4-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 57 and 65;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/4/b" id="article-4-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 4.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5" id="article-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>1st October 2006 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/a" id="article-4-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 63, 64 and 66 to 69;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/b" id="article-4-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 7;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c" id="article-4-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 8—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/i" id="article-4-5-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 5, 26 to 28, 31 and 35;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/ii" id="article-4-5-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph 45, sub-paragraph (3) and paragraph (1) so far as it relates to that sub-paragraph;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/iii" id="article-4-5-c-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 47 and 48;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/iv" id="article-4-5-c-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 51 and 52, and paragraph 49 so far as it relates to those paragraphs;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/c/v" id="article-4-5-c-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 56 to 61;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/d" id="article-4-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 80(1) so far as it relates to the provisions specified in sub-paragraph (c);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/4/5/e" id="article-4-5-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 80(2) and Schedule 9, so far as they relate to the repeal or revocation of the enactments specified in the Schedule to this Order.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>1st October 2006 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions in the Act, except so far as relating to Welsh NHS bodies—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/a" id="article-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 56 and Schedule 3;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/b" id="article-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 24(a), 39 to 42 and 44 of Schedule 8, and section 80(1) in so far as it relates to those provisions; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c" id="article-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Schedule 9, the following repeals and revocations—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/i" id="article-5-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs (1)(g) and 1C of Schedule 2 to the Audit Commission Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/ii" id="article-5-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>Government Resources and Accounts Act 2000 (Audit of Health Service Bodies) Order 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/iii" id="article-5-c-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>Government Resources and Accounts Act 2000 (Audit of Health Service Bodies) Order 2004<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/iv" id="article-5-c-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>Regulatory Reform (National Health Service Charitable and Non-Charitable Trusts Accounts and Audit) Order 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/c/v" id="article-5-c-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>Special Health Authorities (Audit) Order 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/5/d" id="article-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 80(2) in so far as it relates to the repeals or revocations specified in paragraph (c).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1" id="article-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Notwithstanding the substitution, except so far as relating to Welsh NHS bodies, of section 98 of the 1977 Act by section 56 of the Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/a" id="article-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 98 of the 1977 Act;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b" id="article-6-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the following provisions of the Audit Commission Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/i" id="article-6-1-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 5(1)(a);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/ii" id="article-6-1-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “health service body” in section 53(1);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/b/iii" id="article-6-1-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 1(e) and (g), 1A and 1C of Schedule 2;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/c" id="article-6-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 144(2) of the Government of Wales Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/d" id="article-6-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 14 of the Government Resources and Accounts Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/>; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/1/e" id="article-6-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>article 2(1) of the Special Health Authorities (Audit) Order 2006,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<Text>as in force on 30th September 2006 shall apply as regards accounts kept by the bodies listed in section 98(1) in relation to the financial year ending 31st March 2007 (accordingly, the arrangements set out in the new Schedule 12B of the 1977 Act shall apply in relation to each subsequent financial year) and as regards outstanding matters relating to earlier financial years.</Text>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/2" id="article-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notwithstanding paragraph (1)(a), section 98(4) of the 1977 Act (as it continues in effect by virtue of paragraph (1)(a)) shall not apply in relation to any Special Health Authority in relation to the financial year ending 31st March 2007</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/2603/article/6/3" id="article-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraphs (1) and (2) have no effect in relation to Welsh NHS bodies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

act.title: Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act

unit.text: 29th January 2007 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Act in so far as they are not already in force– a

UK_uksi_2006_3397/3f3b870a78.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 (Commencement) (No. 11) Order 2006</dc:title><Made Date="2006-12-12"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 (Commencement) (<Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 11) Order 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic Act 1988 c. 52">1988 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Road Traffic (NHS Charges) Act 1999 c. 3">1999 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Road Traffic (<Acronym Expansion="National Health Service">NHS</Acronym> Charges) Act 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 c. 43">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order applies in relation to England and Wales, except for article 5 which applies in relation to England only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>28th January 2007 is the appointed day for the coming into force of section 150(1) to (7) and (10) to (14) of the Act in so far as it is not already in force<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>29th January 2007 is the appointed day for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Act in so far as they are not already in force<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 151 to 164<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 166 to 168; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 10.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subject to article 4, 29th January 2007 is the day appointed for the coming into force of the repeals relating to the enactments mentioned in Part 3 of Schedule 14 to the Act which are referred to in paragraph (2), and sections 169 and 196 of the Act in so far as it relates to those enactments.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The enactments specified for the purposes of paragraph (1) are—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the 1999 Act; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the 1988 Act.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Notwithstanding article 3 above, the 1999 Act, as it stood on 28th January 2007, shall continue to have effect in relation to injuries to which it applied which occurred before 29th January 2007.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the 1999 Act continues to apply in accordance with paragraph (1), section 145(6) of the 1988 Act shall be read as if the repeals relating to that section in Part 3 of Schedule 14 to the Act had not been made.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/3397/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/3397/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>15th January 2007 is the appointed day for the coming into force of paragraph 15 of Schedule 9 to the Act and section 147 of the Act insofar as it relates to that paragraph of the Schedule.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Notwithstanding article 2(a), the Town and Country Planning (Applications) Regulations 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> shall, subject to paragraph (2), continue to have effect on and after 30th June 2007.</Text>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/1369/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/1369/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">

</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">

<Text>section 73 and accordingly Schedule 7;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/d" id="article-2-2-d">

<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/e" id="article-2-2-e">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/h" id="article-2-2-h">

<P3para>
<Text>sections 92 and 93; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/2/2/i" id="article-2-2-i">

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions are—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 74 so far as it relates to the provisions specified in subparagraph (f);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 75;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/c" id="article-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 84 (and accordingly Schedule 10), 85 and 86;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/d" id="article-3-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 91 so far as it relates to the provisions specified in subparagraph (g);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/e" id="article-3-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 98 so far as it relates to the provisions specified in subparagraph (h);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/f" id="article-3-2-f">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/g" id="article-3-2-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h" id="article-3-2-h">

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/i" id="article-3-2-h-i">

<P4para>

<Text>section 8(1A) and (1B);</Text>
<Text>section 11(2) and (2A);</Text>
<Text>in section 47(1), the words “; but this subsection does not apply in relation to any designated parking place in Greater London”;</Text>
<Text>section 101(4) to (6); and</Text>
<Text>in section 102(8) the definition of “London authority” and the words “and” preceding it;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/ii" id="article-3-2-h-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the Road Traffic Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>—</Text>
<Text>section 43;</Text>
<Text>sections 65 to 67;</Text>
<Text>sections 69 to 74A;</Text>
<Text>sections 76 to 79;</Text>
</P4para>
<P4para>
<Text>Schedule 3; and</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Schedule 6;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/iii" id="article-3-2-h-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the Local Government Wales Act 1994<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, Schedule 7, paragraph 43(b);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/iv" id="article-3-2-h-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the London Local Authorities Act 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> sections 4, 5, 7 and 8;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/v" id="article-3-2-h-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the Greater London Authority Act 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> sections 283(2) and (4), 284 and 286;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/vi/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/vi" id="article-3-2-h-vi">
<Pnumber>vi</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the London Local Authorities Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>, the definition of “special parking area” in section 3(1) and sections 4 to 14;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/vii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/3/2/h/vii" id="article-3-2-h-vii">
<Pnumber>vii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the London Local Authorities Act 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>, sections 14 and 15.</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>None of the provisions of Part 6 of the Traffic Management Act 2004 or of any regulations or orders made thereunder shall have effect in relation to a parking contravention which occurred before the second appointed day and action may be taken, or if begun continued, by an enforcement authority, an adjudicator or a county court in relation to such a contravention as if none of the provisions of Part 6 had been brought into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2007/2053/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2007/2053/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This article is without prejudice to section 16(1) of the Interpretation Act 1978<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Text>Section 45 of the Road Safety Act 2006 (“<Abbreviation Expansion="Road Safety Act 2006 c. 49">the Act</Abbreviation>”) shall come into force on 30th July 2008.</Text>

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/1862/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/1862/article/3" id="article-3">

</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/1862/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/1862/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 45(3) to (7) of the Act shall not have effect until 1st November 2008.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Housing and Regeneration Act 2008 (Commencement No. 2 and Transitional, Saving and Transitory Provisions) Order 2008</dc:title><Made Date="2008-11-26"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Housing and Regeneration Act 2008 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 2 and Transitional, Saving and Transitory Provisions) Order 2008.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Leasehold Reform, Housing and Urban Development Act 1993 c. 28">1993 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Leasehold Reform, Housing and Urban Development Act 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Housing and Regeneration Act 2008 c. 17">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Housing and Regeneration Act 2008;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Commission for the New Towns">CNT</Abbreviation>” means the Commission for the New Towns;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Homes and Communities Agency">HCA</Abbreviation>” means the Homes and Communities Agency;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Urban Regeneration Agency">URA</Abbreviation>” means the Urban Regeneration Agency;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the commencement date” means 1st December 2008.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 321(1) (repeals) shall come into force on the commencement date, so far as it is not already in force, and so far as it relates to the entries in Schedule 16 to the Act relating to the repeals and revocations listed in the Schedule to this Order.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Anything which, on the commencement date, is in the process of being done by or in relation to the transferor may, so far as it relates to any function transferred by a relevant enactment from the transferor to the transferee, be continued by or in relation to the transferee.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Anything done (or having effect as if done) by or in relation to the transferor for the purposes of or in connection with any function transferred by a relevant enactment from the transferor to the transferee shall, if in force or effective on the commencement date, have effect as if done by or in relation to the transferee so far as that is required for continuing its effect on or after the commencement date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/3" id="article-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any enactment, instrument or other document passed or made before the commencement date shall have effect, so far as necessary for the purposes of or in consequence of paragraph (1) or (2), as if any references (however expressed) to the transferor were references to the transferee.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/4" id="article-7-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The references in paragraphs (1) and (2) to things done include references to things omitted to be done.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/5" id="article-7-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“relevant enactment” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in the case of a transfer from the URA to the HCA, paragraph 4 of Schedule 8 to the Act;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in the case of a transfer from the CNT to the HCA or the Welsh Ministers, paragraphs 8 and 31 of Schedule 5 to the Act and paragraphs 4 to 12, 17, 18, 36, 43, 61, 80 and 82 of Schedule 8 to the Act;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the transferee”—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>where the transferor is the URA, means the HCA;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>where the transferor is the CNT, means the HCA or the Welsh Ministers;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the transferor”, except in the definition of “the transferee”, means the URA or the CNT,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<Text>and the references in this paragraph to the HCA or the Welsh Ministers are to be read as including references to them acting in a particular capacity or in relation to particular matters.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/1" id="article-9-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article is subject to article 10.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/2" id="article-9-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Anything which, on the commencement date, is in the process of being done by or in relation to the URA under a superseded enactment may be continued by or in relation to the HCA under the corresponding provision of the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/3" id="article-9-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any subordinate legislation or other thing done (or having effect as if done) by or in relation to the URA under or for the purposes of a superseded enactment shall, if in force or effective on the commencement date, have effect as if done by or in relation to the HCA under the corresponding provision of the Act so far as that is required for continuing its effect on and after the commencement date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4" id="article-9-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any enactment, instrument or other document (including the Act) passed or made before the commencement date shall have effect, so far as necessary for the purposes of or in consequence of paragraph (2) or (3), as if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/a" id="article-9-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to the HCA included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any superseded enactment had effect, references to the URA;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/b" id="article-9-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to the corresponding provision of the Act included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any superseded enactment had effect, references to the superseded enactment;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/c" id="article-9-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to the URA included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any corresponding provision of the Act has effect, references to the HCA; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/d" id="article-9-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to a superseded enactment included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any corresponding provision of the Act has effect, references to the corresponding provision.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/5" id="article-9-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The references in paragraphs (2) and (3) to things done include references to things omitted to be done.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/6" id="article-9-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article “superseded enactment” means sections 162 and 169 of, and Schedule 20 to, the 1993 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

</ListItem>

</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2" id="article-2">

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The following provisions of Part 1 of the Act shall come into force on the commencement date—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/a" id="article-2-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 4 (powers: general), in relation to the powers brought into force by this Order;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/b" id="article-2-1-b">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/d" id="article-2-1-d">

<P3para>
<Text>section 11 (main powers in relation to acquired land) and Schedule 3;</Text>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/g" id="article-2-1-g">

<Pnumber>r</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 42 (agency arrangements with UDCs);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/s/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/s" id="article-2-1-s">
<Pnumber>s</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 43 (acting with, or for, other persons: general);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/t/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/t" id="article-2-1-t">
<Pnumber>t</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 45 (support services);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/u/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/u" id="article-2-1-u">
<Pnumber>u</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 48 (consents of the Secretary of State);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/v" id="article-2-1-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 50(2) (abolition of the Commission for the New Towns) and, with the exception of the provisions specified in paragraph (2), Schedule 5;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/w/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/w" id="article-2-1-w">
<Pnumber>w</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 56 (consequential amendments) and, with the exception of the provisions specified in paragraph (3), Schedule 8 in so far as it is not already in force;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/x/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/1/x" id="article-2-1-x">
<Pnumber>x</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 57 and 58 (interpretation etc. of Part 1) so far as required for the interpretation of provisions commenced by this article.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The excepted provisions of Schedule 5 mentioned in paragraph (1)(v) are paragraphs 2 to 4, 10 to 24, 27, 28, 30 and 32.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The excepted provisions of Schedule 8 mentioned in paragraph (1)(w) are paragraphs 4(c) and (d), 13, 19(3)(a) and (b), 20(3), 21(3), 35, 44 to 50, 63, in so far as it relates to the repeal of section 158 of, and Schedules 17 and 18 to, the 1993 Act, 65 and 77(3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Anything which, on the commencement date, is in the process of being done by or in relation to the transferor may, so far as it relates to any function transferred by a relevant enactment from the transferor to the transferee, be continued by or in relation to the transferee.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Anything done (or having effect as if done) by or in relation to the transferor for the purposes of or in connection with any function transferred by a relevant enactment from the transferor to the transferee shall, if in force or effective on the commencement date, have effect as if done by or in relation to the transferee so far as that is required for continuing its effect on or after the commencement date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/3" id="article-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any enactment, instrument or other document passed or made before the commencement date shall have effect, so far as necessary for the purposes of or in consequence of paragraph (1) or (2), as if any references (however expressed) to the transferor were references to the transferee.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/4" id="article-7-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The references in paragraphs (1) and (2) to things done include references to things omitted to be done.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/7/5" id="article-7-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“relevant enactment” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in the case of a transfer from the URA to the HCA, paragraph 4 of Schedule 8 to the Act;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in the case of a transfer from the CNT to the HCA or the Welsh Ministers, paragraphs 8 and 31 of Schedule 5 to the Act and paragraphs 4 to 12, 17, 18, 36, 43, 61, 80 and 82 of Schedule 8 to the Act;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the transferee”—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>where the transferor is the URA, means the HCA;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>where the transferor is the CNT, means the HCA or the Welsh Ministers;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the transferor”, except in the definition of “the transferee”, means the URA or the CNT,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<Text>and the references in this paragraph to the HCA or the Welsh Ministers are to be read as including references to them acting in a particular capacity or in relation to particular matters.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/1" id="article-9-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This article is subject to article 10.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/2" id="article-9-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Anything which, on the commencement date, is in the process of being done by or in relation to the URA under a superseded enactment may be continued by or in relation to the HCA under the corresponding provision of the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/3" id="article-9-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any subordinate legislation or other thing done (or having effect as if done) by or in relation to the URA under or for the purposes of a superseded enactment shall, if in force or effective on the commencement date, have effect as if done by or in relation to the HCA under the corresponding provision of the Act so far as that is required for continuing its effect on and after the commencement date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4" id="article-9-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any enactment, instrument or other document (including the Act) passed or made before the commencement date shall have effect, so far as necessary for the purposes of or in consequence of paragraph (2) or (3), as if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/a" id="article-9-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to the HCA included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any superseded enactment had effect, references to the URA;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/b" id="article-9-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to the corresponding provision of the Act included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any superseded enactment had effect, references to the superseded enactment;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/c" id="article-9-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to the URA included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any corresponding provision of the Act has effect, references to the HCA; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/4/d" id="article-9-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any references (however expressed) to a superseded enactment included, in relation to times, circumstances or purposes in relation to which any corresponding provision of the Act has effect, references to the corresponding provision.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/5" id="article-9-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The references in paragraphs (2) and (3) to things done include references to things omitted to be done.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/3068/article/9/6" id="article-9-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article “superseded enactment” means sections 162 and 169 of, and Schedule 20 to, the 1993 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Corporate Manslaughter and Corporate Homicide Act 2007 (Commencement No.1) Order 2008</dc:title><Made Date="2008-02-14"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Corporate Manslaughter and Corporate Homicide Act 2007 (Commencement No.1) Order 2008.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Apart from the provisions mentioned in paragraph (2), the Corporate Manslaughter and Corporate Homicide Act 2007 shall, to the extent that it is not already in force, come into force on 6th April 2008.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Those provisions are—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 10 (power to order conviction etc. to be publicised).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3" id="article-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to anything done or omitted before section 2(1)(d) comes into force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/a" id="article-2-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/b" id="article-2-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 2 has effect with the omission of—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/b/i" id="article-2-3-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>subsection (2), and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/b/ii" id="article-2-3-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definitions in subsection (7) of expressions used in subsection (2),</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<Text>except that those provisions have effect for the purposes of paragraph (a) above.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2008/401/article/2/3/c" id="article-2-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 3(2), 5(3) and 7(1) have effect as if “section 2(1)(a) or (b)” were substituted for “section 2(1)(a), (b) or (d)”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Equality Act 2010 (Commencement No. 1) Order 2010</dc:title><Made Date="2010-07-05"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/1736/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/1736/article/1" id="article-1">

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Equality Act 2006 c. 3">2006 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Equality Act 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>

<ListItem>

</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“subordinate legislation” means Orders in Council, orders, rules or regulations.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/1736/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/1736/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>To the extent that the provisions of the Equality Act 2010 listed in the Schedule to this order confer or relate to the power to make subordinate legislation or guidance, those provisions come into force on the day after the day on which this order is made, for the purpose of enabling subordinate legislation or guidance to be made.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/1736/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/1736/article/3" id="article-3">

<P1para>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The following provisions of the Equality Act 2010 come into force on the day after the day on which this order is made —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/1736/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/1736/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection 211(1) so far as it relates to paragraph 10(1), (2) and (3) and (5) of Schedule 26; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/1736/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/1736/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Paragraph 10(1), (2) and (3) and (5) of Schedule 26.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/1736/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/1736/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">

</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2010</dc:title><Made Date="2010-08-31"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation><Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2010.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order, “<Abbreviation Expansion="Flood and Water Management Act 2010 c. 29">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Flood and Water Management Act 2010.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 4 of the Act (“flood risk management function”) comes into force on 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>September<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010, so far as it provides power for the Minister, as defined in subsection (3) of that section, to make an order under subsection<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>(2)(f) of that section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following sections of the Act come into force on 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>September<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010, so far as required for the exercise of the power in section 4(2)(f) of the Act—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 1 (definitions of “flood” and “coastal erosion”);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 2 (definition of “risk”);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/c" id="article-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 3 (definition of “risk management”);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/2/d" id="article-3-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 6 (other definitions).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/3/3" id="article-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 36 of the Act (water use: temporary bans) comes into force on 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>September<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010, so far as the amendments made by that section provide power for the Minister, as defined in section 76A(4) of the Water Industry Act 1991 (temporary bans: supplemental)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, to make an order under section 76A(2) of that Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The provisions of the Act specified in the Schedule come into force on 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/1" id="article-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Despite the amendments made by section 36 of the Act (which substitutes section 76 of the Water Industry Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991), an existing prohibition or restriction continues in force until 31st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010 unless, before that date, it—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/1/a" id="article-5-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>expires; or</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/1/b" id="article-5-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is varied or revoked under paragraph (2).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A water undertaker may vary or revoke an existing prohibition or restriction before 31st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010 as if it were a prohibition issued under section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>76 of the Water Industry Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991, as in force on 1st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October 2010.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/3" id="article-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A variation must not extend the period of an existing prohibition or restriction beyond 31st<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>October<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/2169/article/5/4" id="article-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article, “an existing prohibition or restriction” means a prohibition or restriction in force on 30th<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>September<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2010 under section<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>76 of the Water Industry Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991, as in force on that date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Section 36 of the Act (water use: temporary bans) comes into force on 1stSeptember2010, so far as the amendments made by that section provide power for the Minister, as defined in section 76A(4) of the Water Industry Act 1991 (temporary bans: supplemental), to make an order under section 76A(2) of that Act.
