<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-c829e0"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the 1966 Act” means the Sea Fisheries Regulation Act 1966<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the 2006 Regulations” means the Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“England” includes the sea adjacent to England to a distance of 12 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Menai Strait Fishery Order Management Association” means the Menai Strait Fishery Order Management Association (Company Registration Number 07163689);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries Committee” means the local fisheries committee for the North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries District referred to in the North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries District Order 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“relevant employee” has the meaning given in paragraph (2);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee” means the local fisheries committee for the South Wales Sea Fisheries District created by Order of the Board of Agriculture and Fisheries on 27th June 1912<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the transfer date” means 1st April 2010; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Wales” has the meaning given by section 158(1) and (3) of the Government of Wales Act 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order, “relevant employee” means—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of article 5, any person—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/a/i" id="article-2-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>who was employed by or on behalf of the South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee immediately before the transfer date, and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/a/ii" id="article-2-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>whose contract of employment has not terminated before the transfer date (whether by expiry of notice, effluxion of time or otherwise); and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the purposes of articles 9 and 10(3), any person—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/i" id="article-2-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>who was employed by or on behalf of the North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries Committee immediately before the transfer date,</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/ii" id="article-2-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>whose contract of employment has not terminated before the transfer date (whether by expiry of notice, effluxion of time or otherwise), and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii" id="article-2-2-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>who was employed in one of the following positions—</Text>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/aa" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/aa" id="article-2-2-b-iii-aa">
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Principal Fishery Officer,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/bb" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/bb" id="article-2-2-b-iii-bb">
<Pnumber>bb</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Senior Fishery Officer, whose principal place of employment immediately before the transfer date was in Wales,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/cc" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/cc" id="article-2-2-b-iii-cc">
<Pnumber>cc</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Fishery Officer, whose principal place of employment immediately before the transfer date was in Wales,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/dd" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/dd" id="article-2-2-b-iii-dd">
<Pnumber>dd</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Fishery Patrol Vessel Master,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/ee" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/ee" id="article-2-2-b-iii-ee">
<Pnumber>ee</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Fishery Patrol Vessel Crew,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/ff" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/ff" id="article-2-2-b-iii-ff">
<Pnumber>ff</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Fishery Patrol Vessel Engineer,</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/gg" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/gg" id="article-2-2-b-iii-gg">
<Pnumber>gg</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Traeth Lafan Project Officer, or</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/hh" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/2/2/b/iii/hh" id="article-2-2-b-iii-hh">
<Pnumber>hh</Pnumber>
<P5para><Text>Marine Biodiversity Officer.</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13" id="article-13">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-aae8bd"/>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/1" id="article-13-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Any provision of the byelaws of the South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee listed at Schedule 3 which—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/1/a" id="article-13-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is in force immediately before article 3 comes into force; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/1/b" id="article-13-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>could have been made in a statutory instrument by the Welsh Ministers under any enactment other than the 1966 Act,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>takes effect after article 3 comes into force as if made by the Welsh Ministers in a statutory instrument under that other enactment in relation to the same area of Wales as the area to which that provision originally applied.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/2" id="article-13-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>To the extent that it could have been made in a statutory instrument by the Welsh Ministers under section 5 of the Sea Fish (Conservation) Act 1967<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> and section 189 of the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/>, byelaw 38 (maximum vessel size) of the South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee takes effect, with the omission of paragraph 3 of that byelaw, after article 3 comes into force as if made by the Welsh Ministers in a statutory instrument under those Acts in relation to the same area of Wales as the area to which that provision originally applied.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3" id="article-13-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any provision of the byelaws of the North Western and North Wales Sea Fisheries Committee listed at Schedule 4 which—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3/a" id="article-13-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is in force immediately before article 3 comes into force;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3/b" id="article-13-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>relates to any part of Wales; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/3/c" id="article-13-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>could have been made in a statutory instrument by the Welsh Ministers under any enactment other than the 1966 Act,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>takes effect after article 3 comes into force as if made by the Welsh Ministers in a statutory instrument under that other enactment in relation to the same area of Wales as the area to which that provision originally applied.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4" id="article-13-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any provision of the byelaws made by the Environment Agency, or its predecessors, whilst exercising the powers of a local fisheries committee<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> and listed at Schedule 5 which—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/a" id="article-13-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is in force immediately before article 3 comes into force;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/b" id="article-13-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>relates to any part of Wales; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/4/c" id="article-13-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>could have been made in a statutory instrument by the Welsh Ministers under any enactment other than the 1966 Act,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>takes effect after article 3 comes into force as if made by the Welsh Ministers in a statutory instrument under that other enactment in relation to the same area of Wales as the area to which that provision originally applied.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/5" id="article-13-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>There may be continued by or in relation to the Welsh Ministers anything (including legal proceedings) which relates to any of the byelaws falling within paragraphs (1) to (4), and is in the process of being done immediately before article 3 comes into force to the extent that the Welsh Ministers could lawfully undertake or be involved in that action.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6" id="article-13-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Anything which was done by—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/a" id="article-13-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the South Wales Sea Fisheries Committee;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/b" id="article-13-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the North Western and North Wales Sea Fishery Committee; or</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/6/c" id="article-13-6-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Environment Agency, or its predecessors, whilst exercising the powers of a local fisheries committee,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<Text>for the purpose of or in connection with any of the byelaws falling within paragraphs (1) to (4) and which is in effect immediately before the transfer date, has effect on and after the transfer date as if done by the Welsh Ministers to the extent that the Welsh Ministers could lawfully undertake or be involved in that action.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2010/630/article/13/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2010/630/article/13/7" id="article-13-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Welsh Ministers are substituted for the Environment Agency, or its predecessors, in any instruments or contracts which are either made or commenced before the transfer date and which relate to any of the byelaws falling within paragraph (4).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: The following provisions of the 2010 Act come into force on 19thJuly 2011 in relation to England only— a

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional Provisions) (England) Order 2011</dc:title><Made Date="2011-07-18"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement No.<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1 and Transitional Provisions) (England) Order 2011.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order, “the 2010 Act” means the Flood and Water Management Act 2010.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 2010 Act come into force on 19th<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>July 2011 in relation to England only—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 11 (effect of national and local strategies: England);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 18 (Environment Agency: reports);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 31 (amendment of other Acts), so far as it relates to the provisions of Schedule 2 commenced by this article;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 24 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Coast Protection Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/e" id="article-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 29, 30, 35, 36, 38 and 39 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Land Drainage Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/3/f" id="article-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 45 to 47 and 49 of Schedule 2 (amendment of the Water Resources Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Despite the amendments made by paragraphs 1 to 24 of Schedule 2 to the 2010 Act, the provisions of the Coast Protection Act 1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> as in force immediately before 19th<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>July 2011 continue to apply to any coast protection work started before that date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Despite the amendment made by paragraph 30 of Schedule<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2 to the 2010 Act, section 17 of the Land Drainage Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> continues to apply to a local authority for an area in England unless the lead local flood authority for that area has published a summary of its local flood risk management strategy under section 9(7) of the 2010 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/1770/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“coast protection work” has the meaning given in section 49(1) of the Coast Protection Act<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1949<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> as in force immediately before 19th<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>July 2011; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“local authority” has the meaning given in section 72(1) of the Land Drainage Act 1991.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: The following provisions of the 2010 Act come into force on 1stOctober 2011— a

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement No. 4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2011</dc:title><Made Date="2011-09-05"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2204/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2204/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Order may be cited as the Flood and Water Management Act 2010 (Commencement No.<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>4 and Transitional Provisions) Order 2011.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2204/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2204/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In this Order, “the 2010 Act” means the Flood and Water Management Act 2010.</Text>
</P1para>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/2" id="article-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2204/article/5/3" id="article-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>

</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“local authority” has the meaning given in section 72(1) of the Land Drainage Act 1991.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/57/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/57/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Localism Act 2011 c. 20">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Localism Act 2011;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Town and Country Planning Act 1990 c. 8">1990 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Town and Country Planning Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Housing Act 1996 c. 52">1996 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Housing Act 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Local Government Act 2000 c. 22">2000 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Local Government Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Planning Act 2008 c. 29">2008 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Planning Act 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/57/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/57/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/57/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/57/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where, before 15th January 2012, a local authority in England held a referendum to approve a change in governance arrangements under Part 2 of the 2000 Act, that referendum is to be treated as “Referendum A” for the purposes of section 9MF(1) of the 2000 Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/57/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/57/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where, before 15th January 2012, the implementation of the existing form of governance or existing form of executive of a local authority in England was approved in a referendum held under Part 2 of the 2000 Act, that referendum is to be treated as having been held under Chapter 4 of Part 1A of the 2000 Act for the purposes of section 9M(2)(b) of the 2000 Act;</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/57/article/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/57/article/7/3" id="article-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulations made under section 34 or 45 of the 2000 Act continue to have effect until such time as regulations made under section 9MC or 9MG of the 2000 Act come into force, notwithstanding the commencement of the amendments effecting the repeal of sections 34 or 45 so far as they apply in England in article 4.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/57/article/7/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/57/article/7/5" id="article-7-5">

</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xiii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xiii" id="article-2-a-xiii">
<Pnumber>xiii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 38 (green deal installation apprenticeships);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xiv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xiv" id="article-2-a-xiv">
<Pnumber>xiv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 39 (Parliamentary procedure in relation to code of practice);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xv" id="article-2-a-xv">
<Pnumber>xv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 40 (regulations and orders);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xvi/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/a/xvi" id="article-2-a-xvi">
<Pnumber>xvi</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 41 (Crown application: Chapter 1);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part 2 (security of energy supplies) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b/i" id="article-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>sections 82 to 91 (upstream petroleum infrastructure) and Schedule 2 (upstream petroleum infrastructure: minor and consequential amendments);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b/ii" id="article-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 92 (downstream gas processing facilities);</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/b/iii" id="article-2-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 108 (carbon dioxide pipelines: powers of compulsory acquisition).</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part 5 (miscellaneous and general) section 118 (amendment and repeal of measures relating to home energy efficiency).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1" id="article-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following provisions of Chapter 1 of Part 1 of the Act (green deal) come into force on the day after this Order is made so far as is necessary for the purposes set out in paragraph (2)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/a" id="article-3-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 1 and 2 (green deal plans);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/b" id="article-3-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 4, 5, 7 to 9 and 11 (green deal plan);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/c" id="article-3-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 12, 13, 14(1) to (5) and 14(9) (disclosure of green deal plan etc);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/1/d" id="article-3-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 29 (early repayment of green deal finance).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2" id="article-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The purposes are –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/a" id="article-3-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>interpreting any provision of Chapter 1 of Part 1, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/3/2/b" id="article-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>enabling the exercise on or after that day of any power to make an order or regulations or issue a code of practice that is conferred by virtue of those provisions or any other provision of Chapter 1 of Part 1.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions shall continue to apply and have effect as if the provisions had not been repealed or amended in relation to an application made to the Secretary of State before the coming into force of sections 82 to 92 and Schedule 2 of the Act–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 10E to 10F of the Pipe-lines Act 1962<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> (provisions for securing that upstream petroleum pipe-lines are so used as to reduce necessity for construction of other etc);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 12 of the Gas Act 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> (acquisition of rights to use gas processing facilities);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/c" id="article-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 17F and 17G of the Petroleum Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> (acquisition of rights to use controlled petroleum pipelines);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/d" id="article-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 80 to 82 of the Energy Act 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> (third party access to oil processing facilities);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2012/873/article/4/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2012/873/article/4/e" id="article-4-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 112 of the Energy Act 2008 (extent).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Growth and Infrastructure Act 2013 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional and Saving Provisions) Order 2013</dc:title><Made Date="2013-05-08"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Growth and Infrastructure (Commencement No.1 and Transitional and Saving Provisions) Order 2013.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Statutory Orders (Special Procedure) Act 1945 c. 18">1945 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Statutory Orders (Special Procedure) Act 1945<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Planning Act 2008 c. 29">2008 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Planning Act 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Growth and Infrastructure Act 2013 c. 27">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Growth and Infrastructure Act 2013”;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“development consent” means an order granting development consent under section 37<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> of the Planning Act 2008; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Examining authority” has the same meaning as set out in section 86<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> to the 2008 Act.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 1 and Schedule 1, to the extent that the provisions inserted into the Town and Country Planning Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> by that section and Schedule enable the Secretary of State to make regulations or orders, come into force on the day after the day on which this Order is made.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 8 of the Act comes into force on 25th June 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 5 to 8, the following provisions of the Act come into force on 25th June 2013—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/a" id="article-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 22;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/b" id="article-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 23;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/c" id="article-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 24; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/4/d" id="article-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 25(1) to (6) and (10) insofar as it relates to an order which is subject to the provisions of the 1945 Act by virtue of section 130<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>, 131 or 132 of the 2008 Act.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following transitional and savings provisions have effect.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The amendments made to the 2008 Act by section 23 of the Act shall apply only in respect of applications for development consent made on or after 25th June 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/1" id="article-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subject to paragraphs (2) to (3), the repeals and amendments of the 2008 Act made by section 24 of the Act shall apply only in respect of applications for development consent made on or after 19th October 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the Examining authority has completed its examination of an application referred to in paragraph (1) for the purposes of section 99 of the 2008 Act on or before 25th June 2013, the 2008 Act shall apply without any of the repeals or amendments in section 24.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3" id="article-7-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Except where paragraph (2) applies, where an application for development consent referred to in paragraph (1) is made on or after 19th October 2012 but on or before 24th June 2013 the 2008 Act shall apply subject to the repeals and amendments made by section 24 as modified as follows—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/a" id="article-7-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 131(3)(b) is to be read as if it said “the Secretary of State issues a certificate to that effect”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/b" id="article-7-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 131(6) to (10) (provision about certificates under section (3)(b)) is to apply as if the repeal in section 24(2)(c) were omitted,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/c" id="article-7-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 132(2)(b) is to be read as if it said “the Secretary of State issues a certificate to that effect”, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/7/3/d" id="article-7-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 132(6) to (10) (provision about certificates under section (2)(b)) is to apply as if the repeal in section 24(3)(c) were omitted.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/8/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/8/1" id="article-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (2), the amendments to the 1945 Act made by section 25(1) to (6) and (10) shall apply only in respect of applications for development consent made on or after 19 October 2012.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/8/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/8/2" id="article-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the Examining authority has completed its examination of an application for the purposes of section 99 of the 2008 Act on or before 25 June 2013 then any order made in respect of that application shall be subject to the provisions of the 1945 Act without any of the amendments made by section 25 of the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Subject to articles 10 and 11, section 27 of the Act comes into force on 25 June 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/10" id="article-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following transitional provisions have effect.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1124/article/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1124/article/11" id="article-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The amendments made by section 27 of the Act shall apply only in respect of applications for development consent made to the Secretary of State on or after 25 June 2013.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

unit.text: Section 1 of the 2008 Act comes into force on 26th June 2015, to the extent that it is not already in force.

UK_uksi_2013_1204/4b84b37540.xml:
<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Education and Skills Act 2008 (Commencement No. 9 and Transitory Provision) Order 2013</dc:title><Made Date="2013-05-23"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1204/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1204/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1204/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1204/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Education and Skills Act 2008 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 9 and Transitory Provision) Order 2013.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1204/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1204/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Education and Skills Act 2008 c. 25">2008 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Education and Skills Act 2008.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1204/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1204/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 2008 Act come into force on 28th June 2013—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1204/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1204/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 1 (persons to whom Part 1 applies) with the substitution of “the first anniversary of the date on which the person ceased to be of compulsory school age” for “the age of 18” in subsection (b);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/1204/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/1204/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 2 (duty to participate in education or training);</Text>

<Text>This Order may be cited as the Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6, Transitional Provisions and Savings) Order 2014.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-40559c"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The following provisions of the Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 (so far as not already brought into force) come into force on 1st April 2014—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/a" id="article-2-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 25(3) (the Competition and Markets Authority: duty to promote competition);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>section 26 (abolition of the Competition Commission and the <Abbreviation Expansion="Office of Fair Trading">OFT</Abbreviation>);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/b" id="article-2-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part 4 (competition reform)—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 29 to 51 (mergers, markets, anti-trust, cartels, <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>sections 54 to 58 (miscellaneous);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/c" id="article-2-1-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 4 (the Competition and Markets Authority);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/d" id="article-2-1-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedules 5 to 13 (amendments relating to Part 3, Part 4, etc.);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/e" id="article-2-1-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 1 to 19 and 23 to 29 of Schedule 14 (regulators: use of powers under the 1998 Act<SmallCaps>)</SmallCaps>; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/1/f" id="article-2-1-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 15 (minor and consequential amendments: Part 4).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Schedule contains transitional provisions and savings relating to the provisions brought into force by paragraph (1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-da4417"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Enterprise and Regulatory Reform Act 2013 come into force on 6th April 2014—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 60 (listed buildings in England: agreements and orders granting listed building consent);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 61 (listed buildings in England: certificates of lawfulness);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 66 (Equality Act 2010<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>: obtaining information for proceedings);</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 16 (local listed building consent orders: procedure); and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/416/article/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/416/article/3/e" id="article-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraphs 11 and 14 to 19 of Schedule 17 (consequential amendments to the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>) and section 63 so far as relating to those paragraphs.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Wreck Removal Convention Act 2011 (Commencement) Order 2015</dc:title><Made Date="2015-01-28"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-1f5676"/>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Wreck Removal Convention Act 2011 (Commencement) Order 2015.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order “<Abbreviation Expansion="Wreck Removal Convention Act 2011 c. 8">the Act</Abbreviation>” means the Wreck Removal Convention Act 2011.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-08e4bd"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 1 of the Act comes into force on 5th<Superior> </Superior>February 2015 insofar as it inserts sections 255A (“the Wrecks Convention”), 255J (Wreck removal insurance), 255N (issue of certificates) and 255R (interpretation <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>) and Schedule 11ZA into the Merchant Shipping Act 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> for the purposes set out in paragraph (2).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The purposes are to enable the Secretary of State—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2/a" id="article-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to issue wreck removal insurance certificates in accordance with section 255N,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to make regulations under section 302 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 prescribing the fees to be charged in respect of the issue of such certificates, and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/2/2/c" id="article-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by order to describe the United Kingdom’s Convention area.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/133/article/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/133/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-214693"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Act comes into force on 14th April 2015, so far as it is not already in force on that date.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 (Commencement No. 6 and Saving) (England and Wales) Order 2015</dc:title><Made Date="2015-03-02"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/1" id="article-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/1/1" id="article-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Order may be cited as the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 (Commencement <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 6 and Saving) (England and Wales) Order 2015.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This Order extends to England and Wales.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/1/3" id="article-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Article <InternalLink Ref="article-2" id="i00002" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/2" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/2/made">2</InternalLink> applies to England only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/1/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/1/4" id="article-1-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Article <InternalLink Ref="article-3" id="i00003" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/3" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/3/made">3</InternalLink> applies to Wales only.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/1/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/1/5" id="article-1-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989 c. 14">1989 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 c. 16">2005 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 2005 Act come into force, for the purpose of making regulations and issuing guidance, on the day after the day on which this Order is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 37 (enforcement powers); and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 46<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> (power to search and seize vehicles).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Part 9 of Schedule 5 to the 2005 Act (repeals: use of fixed penalty receipts), so far as not already in force, comes into force on the day after the day on which this Order is made.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The following provisions of the 2005 Act come into force on 6th April 2015 so far as not already in force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 37; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 46.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Part 4 of Schedule 5 to the 2005 Act, the repeal of section 6 of the 1989 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> (seizure and disposal of vehicles used for illegal waste disposal), except in relation to section 6(1)(c) and (5) to (7) for the purpose of making regulations, comes into force on 6th April 2015.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Part 4 of Schedule 5 to the 2005 Act, the repeal of section 6 of the 1989 Act, so far as not already in force, comes into force on 6th April 2015 immediately after the coming into force of the Control of Waste (Dealing with Seized Property) (England and Wales) Regulations 2015<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the repeal of section 6 of the 1989 Act, that section continues to have effect in relation to any vehicle seized under that section before 6th April 2015.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2para>
<Text>In this Order—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989 c. 14">1989 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 c. 16">2005 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the 2005 Act come into force, for the purpose of making regulations and issuing guidance, on the day after the day on which this Order is made—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 37 (enforcement powers); and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 46<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> (power to search and seize vehicles).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Part 9 of Schedule 5 to the 2005 Act (repeals: use of fixed penalty receipts), so far as not already in force, comes into force on the day after the day on which this Order is made.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1" id="article-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The following provisions of the 2005 Act come into force on 6th April 2015 so far as not already in force—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/a" id="article-4-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 37; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/1/b" id="article-4-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 46.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/2" id="article-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Part 4 of Schedule 5 to the 2005 Act, the repeal of section 6 of the 1989 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> (seizure and disposal of vehicles used for illegal waste disposal), except in relation to section 6(1)(c) and (5) to (7) for the purpose of making regulations, comes into force on 6th April 2015.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/4/3" id="article-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Part 4 of Schedule 5 to the 2005 Act, the repeal of section 6 of the 1989 Act, so far as not already in force, comes into force on 6th April 2015 immediately after the coming into force of the Control of Waste (Dealing with Seized Property) (England and Wales) Regulations 2015<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/425/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/425/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the repeal of section 6 of the 1989 Act, that section continues to have effect in relation to any vehicle seized under that section before 6th April 2015.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/m" id="regulation-2-m">

<P3para>

</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/n" id="regulation-2-n">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/o/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/o" id="regulation-2-o">

<Text>section 94 (complaints procedure operated by the regulator);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/p/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/p" id="regulation-2-p">

<P3para>
<Text>section 95 (duties on residents and owners);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/q/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/q" id="regulation-2-q">
<Pnumber>q</Pnumber>

<Text>section 96 (contravention notices);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/r/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/r" id="regulation-2-r">
<Pnumber>r</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 97 (access to premises);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/s/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/s" id="regulation-2-s">
<Pnumber>s</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 98 (duty on regulator to enforce Part);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/t/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/t" id="regulation-2-t">

<P3para>
<Text>section 101 (offence: contravention giving rise to risk of death and serious injury);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/u/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/u" id="regulation-2-u">

<Text>section 102 (special measures) and Schedule 7;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/40/regulation/2/v" id="regulation-2-v">
