<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Environment Act 2021 (Commencement No. 9 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2024</dc:title><Made Date="2024-05-14"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/1/1" id="regulation-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations may be cited as the Environment Act 2021 (Commencement No. 9 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2024.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations—</Text>
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-the-act">the Act</Term>” means the Environment Act 2021;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-the-1990-act">the 1990 Act</Term>” means the Environmental Protection Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-the-1991-act">the 1991 Act</Term>” means the Water Industry Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The following provisions of the Act come into force on 17th May 2024—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/a" id="regulation-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 57 (separation of waste);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/b" id="regulation-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>sections 74 to 77 (environmental recall of motor vehicles etc);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/c" id="regulation-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 81 (reporting on discharges from storm overflows), for the purposes of making regulations under section 141DA of the 1991 Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> only;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/2/d" id="regulation-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 82(2) (which relates to the power to make regulations under the 1991 Act), in so far as it is not already in force.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 79 (drainage and sewerage management plans) of the Act comes into force on 1st September 2024, so far as relating to undertakers whose areas are wholly or mainly in England.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 81 of the Act comes into force on 1st January 2025, for all remaining purposes.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (2) applies to arrangements for the collection of household waste from domestic premises in England during the period beginning with the coming into force of section 57(4) of the Act and ending on 31st March 2026.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/2" id="regulation-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this paragraph applies, an English waste collection authority—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/2/a" id="regulation-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>is not required to meet the conditions in section 45A(3) to (8) of the 1990 Act as substituted by section 57(4) of the Act; but</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/2/b" id="regulation-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>must continue to meet the requirement in section 45A(2) of the 1990 Act as that section applied immediately before the coming into force of section 57(4) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/3" id="regulation-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (4) applies to arrangements for the collection of household waste from relevant non-domestic premises and relevant industrial or commercial waste from premises in England during the period beginning with the coming into force of section 57(4) of the Act and ending on 31st March 2025.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4" id="regulation-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this paragraph applies—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/a" id="regulation-5-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>arrangements for household waste to be collected from relevant non-domestic premises—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/a/i" id="regulation-5-4-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>are not required to meet the conditions in section 45AZA(3) to (7) of the 1990 Act as substituted by section 57(4) of the Act; but</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/a/ii" id="regulation-5-4-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>must continue to meet the requirement in section 45A(2) of the 1990 Act as that section applied immediately before the coming into force of section 57(4) of the Act;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/b" id="regulation-5-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>arrangements for relevant industrial or commercial waste to be collected from premises are not required to meet the conditions in section 45AZB(3) to (7) of the 1990 Act as substituted by section 57(4) of the Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/5/4/c" id="regulation-5-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a person who presents any household waste or relevant industrial or commercial waste from premises for collection is not required to meet the requirements in section 45AZA(8) or 45AZB(8) of the 1990 Act as substituted by section 57(4) of the Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This regulation applies to an English waste collection authority specified in the first column of the Table in the Schedule, during the period beginning with 1st April 2026 and ending on the date specified in the corresponding entry in the second column of that Table.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this regulation applies, section 45A of the 1990 Act (England: separate collection of household waste), as substituted by section 57(4) of the Act, has effect as if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2/a" id="regulation-6-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (7), “(e) or” were omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2/b" id="regulation-6-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection (8) were omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/2/c" id="regulation-6-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (10), paragraph (e) were omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this regulation applies, the English waste collection authorities are not required to meet the first condition in section 45A(3) of the 1990 Act in relation to the collection of garden waste where the only other household waste that is to be collected with that garden waste is food waste.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/1" id="regulation-7-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This regulation applies to relevant non-domestic premises located in the area of an English waste collection authority specified in the first column of the Table in the Schedule, during the period beginning with 1st April 2025 and ending on the date specified in the corresponding entry in the second column of that Table.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/2" id="regulation-7-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where this regulation applies, section 45AZA of the 1990 Act (England: separate collection of household waste from relevant non-domestic premises), as inserted by section 57(4) of the Act, has effect as if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/2/a" id="regulation-7-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>subsection (7) were omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/639/regulation/7/2/b" id="regulation-7-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (10), paragraph (e) were omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Energy Act 2023 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2024</dc:title><Made Date="2024-09-02"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>These Regulations may be cited as the Energy Act 2023 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2024.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Energy Act 2023 is 10th September 2024—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/a" id="regulation-2-a">

<P3para>
<Text>section 156 (fusion energy facilities: nuclear site licence not required);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b" id="regulation-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in Part 6 (governance of gas and electricity industry codes)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/i" id="regulation-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>sections 182 to 184 (key definitions for Part 6);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/ii" id="regulation-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 185 (licence under Gas Act 1986 for performance of code management function);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/iii" id="regulation-2-b-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 186 (licence under Electricity Act 1989 for performance of code management function);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/iv" id="regulation-2-b-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>sections 187 to 189 (selection of code manager etc.);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/v" id="regulation-2-b-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>sections 190 and 191 (strategic direction statement for designated documents);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/vi/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/vi" id="regulation-2-b-vi">
<Pnumber>vi</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>sections 192 to 195 (modifications and directions);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/vii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/vii" id="regulation-2-b-vii">
<Pnumber>vii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>sections 196 and 197 (general objectives and reports);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/viii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/viii" id="regulation-2-b-viii">
<Pnumber>viii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>sections 198 and 199 (regulations and interpretation under Part 6);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/ix/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/b/ix" id="regulation-2-b-ix">
<Pnumber>ix</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 200 and Schedules 12 and 13 (transitional provision and pension arrangements);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>

</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/c" id="regulation-2-c">

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/890/regulation/2/d" id="regulation-2-d">

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023 (Commencement No. 2 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2024</dc:title><Made Date="2024-01-25"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/a" id="regulation-2-a">

<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/b" id="regulation-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 81 (alteration of street names: England);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/c" id="regulation-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 94 (national development management policies: meaning);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/d" id="regulation-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 106 (street votes), so far as it confers a power to make regulations and so far as it relates to the provisions of Schedule 9 brought into force by paragraph (q);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/e" id="regulation-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 107 (street votes: community infrastructure levy), so far as it confers a power to make regulations;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/f" id="regulation-2-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 123 (duty in relation to self-build and custom housebuilding);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/g" id="regulation-2-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 129 (hazardous substances consent: connected applications to the Secretary of State);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/h" id="regulation-2-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 140 (enforcement of community infrastructure levy);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/i" id="regulation-2-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 180 (acquisition by local authorities for purpose of regeneration);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/j" id="regulation-2-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 181 (online publicity), so far as it confers a power to make regulations;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/k" id="regulation-2-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 184 (corresponding provision for purchases by Ministers), so far as it relates to the provisions of Schedule 19 brought into force by paragraph (r);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/l/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/l" id="regulation-2-l">
<Pnumber>l</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 185 (time limits for implementation);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/m/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/m" id="regulation-2-m">
<Pnumber>m</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 186 (agreement to vary vesting date);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/n/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/n" id="regulation-2-n">
<Pnumber>n</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 187 (common standards for compulsory purchase data);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/o/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/o" id="regulation-2-o">
<Pnumber>o</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 188 (‘no-scheme’ principle: minor amendments);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/p/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/p" id="regulation-2-p">
<Pnumber>p</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Schedule 5 (alteration of street names: consequential amendments);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/q/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/q" id="regulation-2-q">
<Pnumber>q</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 1 (Town and Country Planning Act 1990), sub-paragraphs (6) to (10) of Schedule 9 (street votes: minor and consequential amendments), so far as they confer a power to make a development order;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/r/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/2/r" id="regulation-2-r">
<Pnumber>r</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>paragraph 1 (online publicity) of Schedule 19 (compulsory purchase: corresponding provision for purchases by Ministers), so far as it confers a power to make regulations.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 135 of the Act (biodiversity net gain: pre-development biodiversity value and habitat enhancement) comes into force on 12th February 2024.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 190 of the Act (power to require prospects of planning permission to be ignored) comes into force, in relation to England, on 30th April 2024.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 189 of the Act (prospects of planning permission for alternative development) comes into force on 31st January 2025.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments made to the Acquisition of Land Act 1981<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>, and consequential amendments to the Compulsory Purchase Act 1965<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>, Compulsory Purchase (Vesting Declarations) Act 1981<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> and Housing Act 1985<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>, by section 185 of the Act do not apply in relation to a compulsory purchase order where—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/1/a" id="regulation-6-1-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>notice of the making of the order pursuant to section 11(1) of the Acquisition of Land Act 1981, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/1/b" id="regulation-6-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>notice of the preparation in draft of the order pursuant to paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 1 of the Acquisition of Land Act 1981,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>has already been published before the day on which that section comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments made to the Compulsory Purchase (Vesting Declarations) Act 1981 by section 186 of the Act do not apply to a general vesting declaration that has been executed under section 4 of the Compulsory Purchase (Vesting Declarations) Act 1981 before the day on which that section comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments made to the Land Compensation Act 1961<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> by section 189 of the Act do not apply to any acquisition where the first relevant notification date is before the date on which section 189 of the Act comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4" id="regulation-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (3) “<Term id="term-relevant-notification-date">relevant notification date</Term>” means the date on which—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/a" id="regulation-6-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an acquisition authorised by a compulsory purchase order—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/a/i" id="regulation-6-4-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>notice of the making of the order, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/a/ii" id="regulation-6-4-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>where the order was made by a Minister, notice of the preparation in draft of the order,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>has been published or served,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/b" id="regulation-6-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an acquisition authorised by a special enactment, the special enactment was introduced to Parliament,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/c" id="regulation-6-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an offer in writing has been made by or on behalf of a relevant authority to negotiate for the purchase of an interest,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/d" id="regulation-6-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of a notice served under any enactment requiring the purchase of an interest (other than as set out in sub-paragraphs (e) to (g) below), the relevant authority is to be deemed to have served a notice to treat in respect of that interest,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/e" id="regulation-6-4-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an acquisition authorised by an order made under the Transport and Works Act 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>, notice of the application for such order was published under article 14 (publicity for application) of The Transport and Works (Applications and Objections Procedure) (England and Wales) Rules 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/f" id="regulation-6-4-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an acquisition authorised by an order made under the Planning Act 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>, the applicant first gave notice of its application under section 56 (notifying persons of accepted application) of that Act, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/4/g" id="regulation-6-4-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of an acquisition authorised by an order made under the Harbours Act 1964<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>, notice of the application for such order was served under paragraph 11 of Schedule 3 (procedure for making harbour revision and empowerment orders) of that Act.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5" id="regulation-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (4) “<Term id="term-special-enactment">special enactment</Term>” means—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/a" id="regulation-6-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a local or private Act which authorises the compulsory purchase of land specifically identified in that Act, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/b" id="regulation-6-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a provision which—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/b/i" id="regulation-6-5-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>is contained in an Act other than a local or private Act, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/5/b/ii" id="regulation-6-5-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>authorises the compulsory purchase of land specifically identified in that Act.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/6" id="regulation-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments made to the Acquisition of Land Act 1981, the Land Compensation Act 1961, the New Towns Act 1981<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>, the Welsh Development Agency Act 1975<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/>, and the Town and Country Planning Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> by section 190 of the Act do not apply in relation to a compulsory purchase order where—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/6/a" id="regulation-6-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>notice of the making of the order pursuant to section 11(1) of the Acquisition of Land Act 1981, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/92/regulation/6/6/b" id="regulation-6-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>notice of the preparation in draft of the order pursuant to paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 1 of the Acquisition of Land Act 1981,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>has already been published before the day on which that section comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Energy Act 2023 (Commencement No. 3) Regulations 2024</dc:title><Made Date="2024-09-13"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/957/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/957/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The day appointed for the coming into force of the following provisions of the Energy Act 2023 is 1st October 2024—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2024/957/regulation/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2024/957/regulation/2/a" id="regulation-2-a">

<P3para>
<Text>subsection (2) of section 166 (amendment of section 4(1) of the Electricity Act 1989 to add prohibition on carrying out unlicensed activity);</Text>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/2/a" id="regulation-6-2-a">

<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/2/b" id="regulation-6-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>notice of the preparation in draft of the order is first published pursuant to paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 1 to the Acquisition of Land Act 1981.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023 (Commencement No. 9) and Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2025</dc:title><Made Date="2025-12-18"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/1/3" id="regulation-1-3">

</P2>

<Text>notice of the preparation in draft of the order is first published pursuant to paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 1 to the Acquisition of Land Act 1981.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2025/1370/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/169/regulation/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/169/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/169/regulation/1/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/169/regulation/1/3" id="regulation-1-3">

<P2para>

<ListItem id="p00102">
<Para>

</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00107">
<Para>

</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00111">
<Para>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of the exercise of the power to make regulations only, the provisions of the Act listed in <InternalLink Ref="regulation-2-2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/2" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/2">paragraph (2)</InternalLink> come into force on 3rd March 2026.</Text>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The provisions referred to in paragraph (1) are—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/169/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para>

<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>

</P3>

</P1para>

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Employment Rights Act 2025 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2026</dc:title><Made Date="2026-01-05"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/3/regulation/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/3/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-63be5c"/>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/3/regulation/1/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/3/regulation/1/1" id="regulation-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations may be cited as the Employment Rights Act 2025 (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2026.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/3/regulation/1/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/3/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations—</Text>
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem id="p00090">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-the-1992-act">the 1992 Act</Term>” means the Trade Union and Labour Relations (Consolidation) Act 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00096">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-the-1996-act">the 1996 Act</Term>” means the Employment Rights Act 1996<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00102">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-the-2025-act">the 2025 Act</Term>” means the Employment Rights Act 2025;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00106">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-acas">ACAS</Term>” means the Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00112">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-parental-leave">parental leave</Term>” means leave under section 76 of the 1996 Act (entitlement to parental leave);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00116">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-paternity-leave">paternity leave</Term>” means leave under section 80A of the 1996 Act (entitlement to paternity leave: birth) or section 80B of that Act (entitlement to paternity leave: adoption)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00122">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-placed-for-adoption">placed for adoption</Term>” means placed—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem id="p00125">
<Para>
<Text>for adoption under the Adoption and Children Act 2002<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> or the Adoption and Children (Scotland) Act 2007<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00133">
<Para>
<Text>with a local authority foster parent who has been approved as a prospective adopter under—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="roman" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem id="p00136">
<Para>
<Text>section 22C of the Children Act 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> (ways in which looked after children are to be accommodated and maintained) by a local authority in England, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00142">
<Para>
<Text>section 81 of the Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act 2014<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> (ways in which looked after children are to be accommodated and maintained) by a local authority in Wales;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem id="p00150">
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-prospective-adopter">prospective adopter</Term>” means a person who has been approved as suitable to adopt a child and has been notified of that decision in accordance with regulation 30B(4) of the Adoption Agencies Regulations 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> or regulation 30B(4) of the Adoption Agencies (Wales) Regulations 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/3/regulation/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/3/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/641/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/641/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The amendments made to the Highways Act 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> by section 33 of the 2025 Act do not apply in relation to an order or scheme where the date in paragraph (2) is before the date on which that section comes into force.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/641/article/7/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/641/article/7/2" id="article-7-2">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2026/641/article/7/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2026/641/article/7/2/b" id="article-7-2-b">

</P2para>
</P2>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The title of this Order is the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 (Commencement No.9 and Saving) (Wales) Order 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/1/2" id="article-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>6 December 2006 is the day appointed for the coming into force of—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/a" id="article-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 57 of the Act insofar as it gives effect to—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/a/i" id="article-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraphs 1, 6 and 9(5) of Schedule 6 to the Act (provisions relating to rights of way improvement plans prepared under sections 60 and 61 of the Act) to the extent that they are not already in force in consequence of the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 (Commencement No.4) (Wales) Order 2004<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/a/ii" id="article-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph 26 of Schedule 6 to the Act (miscellaneous functions of National Park authorities);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/b" id="article-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 69(1) and (3) of the Act (erection or improvement of stiles, etc.) insofar as it provides the power to issue guidance;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/c" id="article-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>section 102 of the Act (repeals) insofar as it gives effect to the entry relating to—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/c/i" id="article-2-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>section 193(2) of the Law of Property Act 1925 (“the 1925 Act”)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> in Part I of Schedule 16 to the Act to the extent that it is not already in force in consequence of the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 (Commencement No.5) (Wales) Order 2004<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/2/c/ii" id="article-2-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph 9 of Schedule 15 to the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> in Part II of Schedule 16 to the Act.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Insofar as it is not already in force, section 69 of the Act (erection or improvement of stiles, etc.) comes into force on 1 April 2007.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2006/3257/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2006/3257/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Notwithstanding the repeal of section 193(2) of the 1925 Act by article 2(c)(i) of this Order, any deed executed under that sub-section which is in force immediately before the coming into force of that article continues to have effect.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2016/452/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2016/452/article/3" id="article-3">

<Legislation xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><dc:title>The Building Safety Act 2022 (Commencement No. 5 and Consequential Amendments) (Wales) Regulations 2024</dc:title><Made Date="2024-04-02"/><Secondary><Body><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1/1" id="regulation-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The title of these Regulations is the Building Safety Act 2022 (Commencement No. 5 and Consequential Amendments) (Wales) Regulations 2024 and they come into force on 25 April 2024.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations—</Text>
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-2005-order">2005 Order</Term>” (“<Term><Emphasis>Gorchymyn 2005</Emphasis></Term>”) means the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-2012-regulations">2012 Regulations</Term>” (“<Term><Emphasis>Rheoliadau 2012</Emphasis></Term>”) means the Energy Performance of Buildings (England and Wales) Regulations 2012<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-approved-inspectors-regulations">Approved Inspectors Regulations</Term>” (“<Term><Emphasis>Rheoliadau Arolygwyr Cymeradwy</Emphasis></Term>”) means the Building (Approved Inspectors etc.) Regulations 2010<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/1/3" id="regulation-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations apply in relation to Wales.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 49(1) and (2) of the Building Safety Act 2022 comes into force on 25 April 2024.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the following provisions (including headings) of the Approved Inspectors Regulations, for “approved inspector”, in each place it occurs, including where it only occurs once, substitute <InlineAmendment>“approver”</InlineAmendment>—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b">

</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 2005 Order is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In article 30(5)(c) after “the approved inspector”, insert <InlineAmendment>“or registered building control approver”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In article 46(3) for “an approved inspector within the meaning of section 49 of the Building Act 1984” substitute <InlineAmendment>“a registered building control approver within the meaning of section 58N of the Building Act 1984”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 32(1)(c)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> of the 2012 Regulations for “an approved inspector for the purposes of the inspector’s” substitute <InlineAmendment>“a registered building control approver for the purposes of the approver’s”</InlineAmendment>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2024/447/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2024/447/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The amendments in regulations 3, 4(3) and 5 do not apply to a person who, by virtue of regulation 4 of the Building Safety Act 2022 (Commencement No 4, Transitional and Savings Provisions) (Wales) Regulations 2024<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/>, continues in the capacity of an approved inspector on or after 6 April 2024.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
